items.statement: FY24 consolidated revenue INR2,345 crores, lower than FY23; EBITDA INR14 crores vs INR36 crores in FY23; operating costs INR484 crores (INR5 cr lower)
items.quote: If you look at it, therefore, from a full year perspective, like I said, the impact of the H1 action, specifically on SRL, meant that our consolidated business revenue was INR2,345 crores, lower than what it was in FY '23. And there was a slight deterioration in the EBITDA. But really, I mean, that's if you look at it, at a snapshot. But if we peel the onion a little bit further and look at it fro

items.statement: Capex plan of INR15 billion for next 2 years for announced projects, largely funded through internal accruals
items.quote: The company has capex plan of around INR15 billion for next 2 years for the announced project, which will be largely funded through internal accruals.

items.statement: Spent INR6.6 billion in FY24 on capital expenses and acquisitions, majorly met from internal accruals
items.quote: During the year, company spent INR6.6 billion in investment across capital expenses and acquisitions, which was majorly met out of its internal

items.statement: Earmarked over INR2,000 crores capital to be invested over next 3 years for portfolio expansion of ~870 rooms and office tower in Powai
items.quote: To fuel this growth, we earmarked over INR2,000 crores as capital to be invested over the next 3 years.

items.statement: Capex of INR1,500 crores for next 2 years including INR700 crores for commercial tower in Powai, spillover capex, DIAL, Dukes expansion, Bangalore addition and renovation
items.quote: On capex, we'll be spending around INR1,500 crores for next 2 years. Out of that, around INR700 crores for commercial tower INR650 crores, INR700 crores at the new commercial tower, which we are adding in Powai.

items.statement: Plan to add ~870 rooms to portfolio along with additional office tower in Powai
items.quote: Our current plan involves adding approximately 870 more rooms to our portfolio along with an additional office tower in Powai.

items.statement: 125-room addition at Marriott Whitefield to take inventory to 520 rooms by end of FY25
items.quote: With strong recovery in Bangalore, we are looking forward to the 125-room addition at the Marriott Whitefield, taking the inventory up to 520 rooms by end of FY '25.

items.statement: Dukes Retreat Lonavala undergoing major upgradation to final inventory of ~145 keys, expected to open by end of calendar year
items.quote: The Dukes Retreat in Lonavala is undergoing a major upgradation and repositioning. The res ort will have a final inventory of approximately 145 keys, and we look forward to welcoming guests to that hotel by end of this calendar

items.statement: Taj Delhi Airport ~390 keys and Hyatt Regency Airoli ~280 keys set to open in FY26 and FY27 respectively
items.quote: As you are aware, we're working on new assets at the Taj Delhi Airport with around 390 keys and Hyatt Regency at Airoli with about 280 keys, is set to open the doors for guests in FY '26 and FY '27, respectively.

items.statement: Second Commercial Tower at Westin Powai complex CIGNUS 2 expected to complete in FY27
items.quote: The construction of the second Commercial Tower or Westin Powai complex CIGNUS 2 is progressing according to schedule and is expected to be completed in FY '27.

items.statement: Acquired Courtyard by Marriott Aravali resort with 158 rooms and 6 acres undeveloped land for future capacity addition
items.quote: This year, we acquired the Courtyard by Marriott, resort in Aravali for an enterprise value of INR315 crores. This property features 158 rooms and is spread across 14 acres of picturesque landscape. The property has 6 acres of undeveloped land, which will allow for capacity addition in the future.

items.statement: Launched Westin HITEC City Hyderabad with 168 rooms in June 2023
items.quote: Earlier in June '23, we launched our second hotel in Hyderabad, The Westin HITEC City Hyderabad with 168 rooms.

items.statement: Expanded Novotel Pune by adding 88 rooms, increasing inventory by ~40%
items.quote: We expanded the capacity at Novotel Pune by adding 88 rooms, increasing inventory by about 40%.

items.statement: Robust demand pickup in Q3 FY24 continued into Q4 led by corporate travel, MICE, weddings and social events
items.quote: For Chalet, the robust pickup of demand seen in Q3 FY '24 continued into the next quarter in Q4, largely led by corporate travel, MICE, weddings and social events.

items.statement: Industry demand growing at 11% while supply inching up at 9%, supply expected to outstrip demand for next 2-4 years
items.quote: I think we've got at least for the visible future, which is the next 2 to 3, 4 years, supply and demand is expected to outstrip supply.

items.statement: Hospitality EBITDA margin 47.8% in Q4 FY24, consolidated EBITDA margin 44.5%, full year hospitality margin 44.4%, consolidated margin 42%
items.quote: Our EBITDA for the Hospitality division was INR1.8 billion with one of the highest EBITDA margins of 47.8%.

items.statement: Same-store hospitality margin 48.4% with 80 bps expansion for quarter and 300 bps for year
items.quote: So our same-store margin is actually at 48.4%, which is margin expansion, if I recall, 80 bps, for the year.

items.statement: Utilities cost at all-time low of 4.1% of revenue due to green power sourcing and energy-efficient equipment
items.quote: Through our constant efforts to sourcing green power and upgrading infrastructure with energy-efficient equipment, we have achieved an all-time low utilities cost, which is 4.1% of revenue, creating new benchmark for the industry.

items.statement: Q4 ADR INR11,862 up 5% YoY, 8% same-store; full year ADR INR10,718 up 17%; RevPAR INR8,984 up 7% YoY
items.quote: Q4 record ed new highs in average room rates at INR 11,862, which is up 5% over the previous year. It is up by 8% on a same-store basis

items.statement: Hyderabad ADR growth ~20% and RevPAR growth ~33% in Q4; Bangalore ADR growth ~26% in Q4
items.quote: And if I was to look at Hyderabad as a percentage of growth, the rate growth there is roughly 20% and our RevPAR growth of 33% there. So clearly, Hyderabad and Bangalore continue to do extremely good.

items.statement: JW Marriott Sahar ADR growth 9% in Q4, 18% for full year
items.quote: One correction, our rate growth there is actually 9%, not 10% for the quarter. However, for the year, it is 18%.

items.statement: Residential receivables INR320 crores against sold inventory, total sales value ~INR550 crores, collected ~INR250 crores
items.quote: Yes, it includes receivable s against sale. I mean the total sale value minus amount, which is collected is shown as receivables. So for the area what we have sold, I mean, the total sales value is around INR550 crores. We've collected around INR250 crores

items.statement: Commercial leasing: Bangalore ~600,000 sq ft leased (2/3 of building), Powai ~140,000 sq ft with 3 deals in final stages
items.quote: We've in the last 1 week, closed another big client. We will come back with the details, but we are now talking about another increase of 175,000-odd square feet to this, which will take us to roughly in excess of 600,000 square feet, which is 2/3 of the building.

items.statement: Net debt INR25 billion as of March 2024, half allocable to CWIP and non-operational assets; cost of finance 8.87%; post-QIP net debt down to INR14.6 billion as of April 30, 2024
items.quote: The net debt as on March '24 was at INR25 billion, marginally up from previous year. Around half of the debt is allocable to capital work in progress and assets not yet operationalized. We closed the year with the cost of finance at 8.87%.

items.statement: Raised INR1,000 crores through QIP in Q4 FY24, used for debt paydown and general corporate purposes
items.quote: In the quarter gone by, the company successfully raised INR1,000 crores through our QIP, further strengthening our balance sheet.

items.statement: Women employee ratio improved from 17% to 22% in FY24
items.quote: Our commitment to diversity and inclusion is reflected in the improvement of women employee ratio from 17% to 22% in FY '24.

items.statement: DJSI score improved to 57 (up 14 points), ranked 8th globally among hospitality companies
items.quote: Our rating at Dow Jones Sustainability Index or DJSI as it's known, reflects an unwavering commitment towards sustainable growth with an overall score of 57, reflecting an improvement of 14 points over the previous score.

items.statement: ADR growth likely to moderate after some time due to higher base effect
items.quote: When ADR growth happen, absolutely. Moderate after some time. Yes, that's also likely to happen.

items.statement: Taj Delhi Airport construction in substructure stage (3 basements), expected completion by Q4 FY26; Airoli approvals expected in couple months, construction to start post-monsoon in October
items.quote: Taj, construction is underway. As you know, this is a warm shell lease from Delhi International Airport Limited. They're doing the construction part. They are still in the substructure stage. There are 3 basements in the property, so a lot's going on that. As per our current estimate, we expect to continue to complete this project by Q4 of '26, which is roughly around 2 years from now.

items.statement: Project LEAP target of ₹200 Bn annual revenue by FY26; new mid-term goal plan to be unveiled during current financial year
items.quote: We are swiftly approaching our project LEAP target of achieving an annual turnover of ₹ 200 Bn. As previously communicated, we will unveil our new mid -term goal plan during the course of the current financial year.

items.statement: International business target of 10% contribution to consolidated revenue by FY26
items.quote: Under our project LEAP, the target that we have taken that we wanted International business to contribute about 10% of our top line by FY26, we should be able to achieve that within that time frame.

items.statement: Cables & Wires sustainable EBIT margin profile of 12-13% over long term
items.quote: We believe that about 12% to 13% is the margin profile that we should be able to consistently deliver on the cables and wires business.

items.statement: EPC business sustainable operating margin expected in high single digit over mid-to-long term
items.quote: Annual sustainable operating margin in this business is expected to be in high single digit over mid-to-long term.

items.statement: FY24 capex of ₹8.6 Bn; ₹10-11 Bn per year for next 2-3 years to expand capacities
items.quote: In FY24, we allocated ₹ 8.6 Billion towards capex. Over the next 2-3 years, we will be investing between ₹ 10 Bn & 11 Bn, each year, to expand our capacities.

items.statement: Cables & Wires capacity utilization in mid-70s during Q4 FY24
items.quote: Largely combined for cables and wires, we were operating in mid-70s during the quarter.

items.statement: EPC open order book of ~₹48-50 Bn to be executed over next 3-4 years, largely from RDSS scheme
items.quote: We have an open order book of almost ₹48 billion in that business which we have to complete over the next 3 years to 4 years.

items.statement: Domestic Cables & Wires volume growth of 30-40% in Q4 FY24 and full year FY24
items.quote: The domestic Cables & Wires business registered a volume growth of between 30% to 40%, both for quarter four as well as for the entire year.

items.statement: Strong demand outlook for next 5-10 years driven by infrastructure, power, renewables, highways, railways, PLI
items.quote: Across all of these sectors, we see enough and more demand coming in over the course of next five to ten years.

items.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin expanded ~70 bps to 13.8% in FY24; Q4 EBITDA margin 13.6%, up ~50 bps QoQ
items.quote: EBITDA was up by 35% year -on-year with margin expansion of ~70 bps to 13.8%.

items.statement: Cables mix shifted from 70:30 (cables:wires) to favor cables by ~200 bps in FY24; LDC cables growing faster than HDC
items.quote: Last year, it was at about 70-30, 70 cables, 30 wires. This year, since cables have grown at a bit faster rate than wires, it would have moved by a couple of hundred basis points in favor of cables.

items.statement: Domestic organized Cables & Wires market share increased to 25-26% from 22-24% previous year; industry share 18-19%
items.quote: We believe Polycab has significantly gained market share during the year, with our share of the domestic organized Cables & Wires market increasing to about 25% - 26%, from the 22% - 24% estimated in the previous year.

items.statement: International business contribution 8.0% of consolidated revenue in FY24; footprint expanded to 79 countries
items.quote: Overall, for the year, contribution from the international business to the consolidated revenue stood at 8.0%. The Company has expanded its global footprint to 79 countries spread across all the continents.

items.statement: Robust pricing mechanism absorbs copper/aluminium price rises without material impact on gross margins or growth
items.quote: We've been in such instances wherein there has been a rise in copper and aluminium in the past, but we have a very robust pricing mechanism within the industry. And we have not seen any material impact of any such rise in copper prices or aluminium prices in the past.

items.statement: Working capital cycle improved to 48 days in FY24 from previous year; net cash position ₹21.4 Bn vs ₹18.9 Bn
items.quote: Net cash position improved to ₹ 21 .4 Bn over ₹ 18.9 Bn in Q4 of the previous year, while working capital cycle, at 48 days, showed a tad improvement over the previous year.

items.statement: Cables & Wires EBIT margin 14.7% and EBITDA margin 16% for FY24 at historic highs
items.quote: If you look at the EBITDA margin, it is at 16%. If we look at the EBIT margins for cables and wires, it's at 14.7%.

items.statement: Income Tax search event: no tax demand notice issued; company confident of compliance and cooperating with department
items.quote: As of the present date, we want to emphasize that no tax demand notice or any other order has been issued to us by the Income Tax department. We are confident of our compliances and remain committed to maintaining full cooperation with the department's investigative process.

items.statement: EPC business growth driven by RDSS government scheme with total outlay ~₹1 lakh Cr; Polycab order book ~₹50 Bn
items.quote: Overall, the total outl ay by the government within this scheme is of about ₹ 1 lakh Cr. And as of now, we would have roughly an open order book of close to ₹50 billion

items.statement: FMEG restructuring: merged all B2C verticals under one head; decentralizing decision-making; closing execution gaps over next 2-3 quarters
items.quote: A large change that we have done is that now we have merged all of the B2C business verticals under one business head. There will be a lot of decentralization of decision -making within that business.

items.statement: Techno Electromech 50:50 JV investment written off (₹105 Mn) due to net worth erosion from lighting price declines
items.quote: An impact of ₹ 105 million was on account of impairment of our investment in Techno Electromech, wherein we have a 50:50 JV. Due to the losses incurred by Techno on account of the continued pricing decline in lights and corresponding impact on business, the net worth of the Company has eroded completely.

items.statement: New competitor capacities (Havells, KEI) not expected to pressure pricing/growth due to strong structural demand for 5-10 years
items.quote: In spite of the other capacities coming up from other players, we don't believe that there will be any such case where there will be any form of pressure on pricing or growth because of capacities. We believe the demand is more than enough to support growth for all the players.

items.statement: Management expects subsidiary HALS revenue to reach ~Rs 800 cr in 2-3 years based on past asset turns of 2.5-2.7x
items.quote: our asset turn h as been close to 2.5 to 2.7, so based on the investment which we have already made, hopefully in the next 2 years to 3 years, the topline should be closer to Rs. 800 crores based on the investments which we have already made this is again as per our past records

items.statement: Targeting 3,000 tons HALS sales by March 2025 (~1/3 of 10,500 ton capacity)
items.quote: Year end by March, right, we should see about 3,000 tons.

items.statement: Subsidiary HALS margin target 15% for FY25, 25% at peak utilization
items.quote: for this year we a re not targeting more than 15% for the subsidiary, for the new products in the subsidiary which is namely HALS

items.statement: Pharma Intermediate commercialization on track for Q3 FY25
items.quote: We are on track to commercialize the capacity for Pharma Intermediate by Q3 FY25.

items.statement: FY24 capex Rs 235 cr (highest ever), including Rs 215 cr in subsidiary CFCL
items.quote: We have incurred the highest CAPEX in the history of Company of approximately Rs. 235 crores during FY24 ; this includes investment in subsidiary of Rs. 215 crores.

items.statement: Pharma Intermediate capex Rs 30 cr; additional Rs 150 cr for Performance Chemicals pending pilot outcomes
items.quote: Rs. 30 crores is the CAPEX for Pharma Intermediate which will start in Q3, an additional Rs. 150 crores CAPEX is based on the pilot runs which we are running as soon as we are successful the additional Rs. 150 crores CAPEX will be made and announcement will also be made for the same.

items.statement: CFCL commercialized in March 2024; HALS 770 commercialized, other grades (622, 944, 119, 2020) to follow in 3-5 weeks
items.quote: During March 24, the operations at C FCL were commercialized, which is in line with our earlier guided timeline.

items.statement: Performance Chemicals, Pharma at ~70% utilization; FMCG at ~75% in Q4 FY24
items.quote: for this quarter performance segment the utilization was close to 70%.

items.statement: Standalone plants at optimal utilization; limited scope for incremental volumes from existing products
items.quote: In Clean Science, yes, we are at optimal levels (these are utilization levels for this quarter).

items.statement: No long-term contracts; business is monthly/quarterly based, especially for UV stabilizers targeting Indian import substitution
items.quote: We don't work like a long-term contract on these businesses. These are quarterly basis businesses or monthly basis businesses because primarily our first markets are Indian market where these UV stabilizers will be sold, so these are decided on monthly or on quarterly basis.

items.statement: Volume recovery across all segments in H2 FY24; Q4 volumes surpassed H1 levels
items.quote: Progressively volumes recovered during H2, in fact, volumes have surpassed during Q4.

items.statement: HALS 770 at ~50% Indian market share (100-110 tons/month); target 60-65% in 3-4 months, 70-80% eventually
items.quote: currently we have at least I think 50% of Indian market is now supplied by Clean Science and I think over the next 3 months to 4 months period, I think this number from 50% should become 60% to 65%.

items.statement: HALS 701 approved with major global accounts; targeting ~1,000 tons/annum in 3-5 months
items.quote: we have now started giving trial orders or commercial shipments to all our customers and I think over the next 3 months to 5 months-time frame, we should reach a decent volumes of about a 1,000 ton per annum basis.

items.statement: HALS pricing: 2.5-3% discount to imports in India; 5% max discount globally; 701 discount <5% as first non-Chinese producer
items.quote: Typically, this product discount of 2.5% to 3% because we give that advantage of not letting them stock the material.

items.statement: Blended HALS realization $7-8/kg (770 cheapest, 944 $9, 119 $10-12)
items.quote: 7 to 8 now on blended basis , so 770 cheap, 944 is expensive, 119 is expensive , so on blended basis it is $8 you can assume.

items.statement: FY24 sales: Performance Chemicals 67%, Pharma 19%, FMCG 13%; new products 23% of revenue vs 18.5% prior year
items.quote: Further new product contribution increased to 23% from 18.5%.

items.statement: HALS 701 export-driven (water treatment); 770 domestic + export; next grades (622, 944) both markets; 119, 2020 largely export
items.quote: First 701 is export driven and 770 is domestic as well as export. The next products which we are going to launch probably in the next 3 weeks to 4 weeks are 622 , 944 where they have both markets, I mean domestic as well as export.

items.statement: HALS customer base same across grades; existing 770 relationships accelerating approvals for new grades (3-6 months)
items.quote: 3 months to 6 months.

items.statement: No Chinese competition seen in HALS range; volumes intact in China market; pricing kept competitive to deter conventional process entrants
items.quote: In our range, I have not seen any Chinese in this particular range and hence our volumes have remained intact in the China market.

items.statement: FY24 EBITDA margin 43% (steady vs FY23); Q4 EBITDA margin 44%
items.quote: Company reported steady EBITDA margin of 43% for the full year FY24, which is in line with FY23.

items.statement: Pharma Intermediate margins expected better than HALS 25% peak target
items.quote: I think that would be better, much better.

items.statement: Inventory increase QoQ due to higher Q4 sales and WIP; RM/FG inventory <30 days, no price risk
items.quote: otherwise raw material or finished good inventory is less than 30 days, so there is no price risk there.

items.statement: Cash balance Rs 340 cr despite high capex and increased dividend payout (21.4% vs 17.5%)
items.quote: Led by strong focus towards cash conversion, the cash balance continues to be meaningful at Rs. 340 crores despite increased payout ratio and significant CAPEX done during the financial year.

items.statement: Final dividend Rs 3/share recommended; FY24 payout ratio 21.4% vs 17.5% in FY23
items.quote: We are also pleased to announce the Board has recommended final dividend of Rs. 3 per share, so the total dividend payout ratio increased to 21.4% for F Y24 versus 17.5% from FY23.

items.statement: Export market ramp-up slower due to approval processes, distributor appointments, US stocking requirements
items.quote: export market typically takes a little longer because the approval process then appointing right distributors , stocking the material in USA , so USA could take a little longer

items.statement: Plan to double Blinkit store count in next 12 months, mostly in top 7-8 cities
items.quote: Broadly what we are saying is that the store count will double from here over the next 12 months and most of those stores will come in the top 7-8 cities.

items.statement: Food delivery GOV growth guided at 20%+
items.quote: We expect that as the business GOV continues to grow 20%+ (which we have guided on), that will likely be a combination of some AOV increase and order volume increase.

items.statement: Blinkit to remain at least EBITDA neutral during aggressive expansion
items.quote: Our attempt is to keep reinvesting back into the business to grow as fast as possible while maintaining neutrality on the EBITDA side - that's our strategy.

items.statement: Blinkit steady-state margin target around 4-5% of GOV
items.quote: you mentioned in the shareholders' letter that a steady-state margin for the business could be around 4% to 5%.

items.statement: New Blinkit stores take longer than 2 months to reach contribution breakeven
items.quote: We expect that it will not increase meaningfully (time to breakeven), but it will be higher than the two months that we have put in our last letter.

items.statement: Top 4-5 metros can each support 500 Blinkit stores long-term
items.quote: each of these 4/5 top metros can easily have, for example, 500 stores each.

items.statement: Zomato Everyday expanding to Mumbai and Bengaluru over next few months
items.quote: over the next few months, we'll see maybe Mumbai and Bengaluru being added as cities where we'll launch Everyday.

items.statement: Blinkit GOV could grow 4x as non-Delhi metros reach Delhi NCR scale
items.quote: over time, as these markets get to the scale that we are at in Delhi NCR today, would mean that the business would have grown by 4x.

items.statement: Hyperpure EBITDA margin improved from -9% to -2% YoY, improvement to continue
items.quote: directionally, the EBITDA margins have improved from negative 9% in Q4 last year to negative 2% now, and we expect that change to continue.

items.statement: Blinkit contribution margin improved despite new store additions
items.quote: the increase in contribution you see is a function of the negative impact of new stores and the positive impact of the older stores increasing in terms of profitability.

items.statement: Blinkit charges INR 20 per delivery, will not compete on discounting
items.quote: our focus is to build a valuable service that customers actually are willing to pay more for rather than trying to provide an inferior service and leaning on discounting to grow.

items.statement: Blinkit take rate increased 1 percentage point QoQ, driven by commissions, ads, delivery fees
items.quote: The take rate has increased by one percentage point in this quarter. And it's a composite number, including product margin, ad income, and delivery charges.

items.statement: Blinkit advertising revenue expected to increase, major driver of unit economics
items.quote: broadly we expect the advertising revenue in Blinkit to increase from where we are today. But at this point, we don't want to give a guidance on where it can go.

items.statement: Food delivery transacting customers grew ~10% YoY
items.quote: on the food delivery side, the ATC's have grown by about 10% YoY.

items.statement: Blinkit expansion driven by business confidence, not competition
items.quote: I don't think this has anything to do with competition or even margins. It's more dictated by the confidence we have in the business.

items.statement: Blinkit claims largest GOV share in Bengaluru and Mumbai
items.quote: even in Bengaluru and Mumbai, we believe we are already the largest player in terms of GOV.

items.statement: Total employee cost (ESOP + cash) as % of Adjusted Revenue fell from 29% in FY22 to 12% in FY24, expected to continue declining
items.quote: that expense as a percentage of Adjusted Revenue has come down meaningfully from 29% in FY22 to 12% in FY24. And we expect that to continue.

items.statement: ESOP pool expanded by 2%, expected to last 5+ years
items.quote: we just wanted to expand that a little bit by 2% right now and we believe then with that, we should be good for the next 5 years at least.

items.statement: ESOP cost increased to INR 161 crore in Q4, will increase further
items.quote: Yes, it will increase from INR 161 crores for sure going forward.

items.statement: Key worries: maintaining innovation pace and team mindset
items.quote: we have to innovate on behalf of our customers. And we have to be paranoid about not falling behind on that innovation ladder.

items.statement: Blinkit MTCs expected to cross Zomato food delivery MTCs eventually
items.quote: Absolutely. I think that seems like it will happen.

items.statement: Blinkit average throughput per store expected to increase directionally over time
items.quote: directionally, we expect the average throughput per store to continue to increase over time.

items.statement: Blinkit AOV dip in Q4 attributed to seasonality, YoY assortment expansion still driving AOV up
items.quote: Seasonal factor. Even last year, we saw that dip in Q4, if you recall, and this year, the dip has been significantly lower than what we had last year.

items.statement: Blinkit city mix (top 8 vs non-top 8) to remain ~75/25, limiting blended AOV impact
items.quote: only about 75% of the stores we opened were in the top 8 cities, 25% stores were still in the non-top 8 cities. So that mix of top 8 and non-top 8 cities is likely to remain the same.

items.statement: Real estate pipeline healthy, no material issues securing dark store locations
items.quote: So far, we have not faced any material issues in being able to get the kind of real estate that we're looking for.

items.statement: Targets 25% revenue growth for FY25 with H2 skew due to CDMO ramp-up
items.quote: I firmly believe we will sustain our growth trajectory target, targeting for a revenue growth of 25% for the year FY '25.

items.statement: Expects H1:H2 revenue split of 40:60 in FY25 vs historical 45:55 due to CDMO commercialization in H2
items.quote: Now, given we are expecting CDMO contract commercializing in H2 FY '25, the split will readjust to 40:60 ratio.

items.statement: Q4 FY24 EBITDA margin at 19.2%, up 326 bps sequentially but down 269 bps YoY
items.quote: EBITDA margin continued strong sequential growth trend, coming in at 19.2% for the quarter, which is down by 269 basis points on Y-o-Y basis and expansion of 326 basis points on a sequential basis.

items.statement: Targets return to historical 21% EBITDA margin base then further improvement
items.quote: Our first target is to go back to our previous base margin of 21%. So that is our first target. And from there onwards, we will see, again, a good growth journey.

items.statement: Existing CDMO project expected to ramp up from H2 FY25 with confirmed order in hand
items.quote: I would like to highlight that our existing CDMO project is expected to ramp up from second half of FY '25 onwards with a confirmed order in hand.

items.statement: Electrolyte additives commercial supplies expected to start Q2 FY25 with firm orders in hand
items.quote: We have a firm order in our hand, and supplies are expected to slowly start it from Q2FY '25 onwards.

items.statement: FY25 capex guided at INR250 crores: INR70 cr balance Ankleshwar Unit 2, INR100 cr electrolyte additives, INR50 cr solar, INR30-40 cr maintenance
items.quote: For the year FY '25, we are expecting capex to be around INR250 crores. Split of the current capex will be, around INR70 crores is the pending capex of Ankleshwar Unit 2; around INR100 crores capex related to electrolyte additive and related infrastructure; and INR50 crores capex towards the captive solar power plant; remaining around INR40-50 crores maintenance capex will be for the FY '25.

items.statement: FY24 capex INR280 crores (INR230 cr Ankleshwar Unit 2); INR240 cr spent of INR310 cr planned for Unit 2
items.quote: Total capex for FY '24 was INR280 crores. Out of those INR280 crores, INR230 crores was towards Unit 2 Ankleshwar capex and remaining was regular maintenance and other capex. Out of INR310 crores capex planned for Unit 2 Ankleshwar, we have spent around INR240 crores till end of FY '24.

items.statement: Unit 1 pharma intermediates utilization at 72% in FY24; specialty chemicals at 50%; Unit 2 just started, utilization to begin FY25

items.statement: Lighting FY24 EBITDA ₹150 crore (+23%), margin 9.57% vs 7.92% FY23; Q4 margin 10.66%

items.statement: Value-added products 45% of steel sales; target >50% soon, 70% of new capex on value-added

items.statement: New capex 70% focused on value-added products; target value-added 75% of profits
items.quote: And in the new capex of ₹500 crores, 70% of the entire investment is on value -added products, that is, high margin products. So moving forward, we will surpass the ratio of 50%, that is our focus area. And at the same time, value-added products will constitute 75% of our profits.

items.statement: API spiral pipe degrowth 32% in FY24 due to no PSU tenders during elections; recovery expected from Q1 FY25
items.quote: The overall API spiral in which the EBITDA per ton is around 15,000 ton - in that segment a total of 32% degrowth was registered. items.statement: Lighting volume growth >20% product-to-product; price erosion 25-30% now netted in schemes

items.statement: Became zero-debt company in FY24; repaid ₹400 crore debt; cash surplus ~₹65 crore
items.quote: We achieved a major milestone by becoming a zero-debt company, having successfully reduced our debt by ₹400 crores in FY '24. Our commitment to financial prudence alongside our operational strategies has helped maintaining a healthy cash surplus of about ₹65 crores.

items.statement: Net working capital 59 days (inventory 48, debtor 31, creditor 21) as of 31 March 2024
items.quote: As on 31st March 24 the net working capital days stood at 59 days, inventory days stood at 48 days, debtor days stood at 31 days and creditor days stood at 21 days.

items.statement: Final dividend ₹2.5/share + interim ₹2.5/share; payout ratio to increase as cash surplus grows
items.quote: We have declared a final dividend of ₹2.5 per share, demonstrating our ongoing commitment to delivering share holders' value. This is in addition to the interim dividend of ₹2.5 per share already, which was disbursed.

items.statement: Payout ratio will increase; excess cash after capex & working capital to shareholders
items.quote: It will increase because we can't give money to third party. This is a shareholder company either we will invest in company or shareholder will get the benefit.

items.statement: No overcapacity risk in India for 20-25 years given demographics and govt capex; focus on value-added to differentiate
items.quote: I don't think there is an overcapacity situation at least in India. Because we have a population of 144 crores, and the Indian government itself is doing a capex of ₹10,00000 crores every year. So, I believe that there is a lot of opportunity and potential for another 20-25 years for India.

items.statement: ROCE 21.14%, ROE 16.33% as of 31 March 2024
items.quote: As on 31st March 24 ROCE stood at 21.14% and ROE stood at 16.33% .

items.statement: Steel price decline ₹3,000/ton impacted revenue ~₹250 crore; zinc price drop ₹70k/ton impact ~₹60 crore; govt sales slowdown ~₹300 crore
items.quote: But this time, the decrease in steel prices is around ₹3000 per ton and that is around ₹250 crores impact in revenue for the whole year and in zinc prices are down by ₹70,000 per ton and its contribution is around 60 crores. And with slowdown government sales impact what I had said earlier is around ₹300crore. So our revenue was impacted by the total of ₹610 crores because of three reasons.

items.statement: Year-end order income growth plans remain intact
items.quote: Our year end Order Income growth plans remain intact.

items.statement: Total CAPEX investment expected to exceed Rs 1,000 crore
items.quote: With this, total CAPEX investment is expected to exceed Rs 1,000 crore.

items.quote: Mobility Business is investing Rs. 186 crore to build a state-of-the-art Metro train manufacturing facility at Aurangabad.

items.quote: In November 2023, we announced plans to double the power transmission capacity from 15 GVA to 30 GVA with a CAPEX investment of Rs. 3,600 million over the next 2-3 years.

items.quote: The order book for the Energy Business as of March 31, 2024 stands at Rs.97.4 Billion.

items.statement: Post-demerger backlog almost Rs 100 billion for Siemens Energy and over Rs 370 billion for new Siemens
items.quote: Both entities will have a healthy backlog, almost Rs. 100 billion for Siemens Energy and over Rs. 370 Billion for the new Siemens.

items.quote: Another highlight of this quarter was EBITDA at 15%. This represents an increase of 240 bps vs. PY quarter.

items.quote: On a comparable basis by excluding FX and Commodity Hedging impact our EBITDA margin improved by 340 bps.

items.quote: After a weaker Q1 we reconfirmed our aspirations of continuous improvements and finished the second quarter with an EBITDA margin of 15%, an increase by 240 bps vs. Q2 of the previous year.

items.statement: Mobility Business EBITDA margin at 7.6% after Q2, up 320 bps YoY
items.quote: After Q2 we are at 7.6% EBITDA margin representing a 320 bps EBITDA margin improvement.

items.statement: Industrial automation seeing slowdown due to normalization of demand after shorter delivery cycles
items.quote: There has also been a slowdown in ordering of industrial automation products due to normalization of demand following shorter delivery cycles.

items.statement: Post-demerger shareholding identical: 69% Siemens AG, 6% Siemens Energy, 25% public; 1:1 share entitlement
items.quote: Post the demerger, both companies would have identical shareholding – 69% by Siemens AG, 6% by Siemens Energy and 25% by the public. Shareholders of Siemens Limited will receive one share of Siemens Energy India Limited for every one share held in Siemens Limited.

items.statement: Smart Infrastructure Goa factory and Mobility bogie factory largely export-oriented; Blue GIS expansion driven by global export demand
items.quote: On the smart infrastructure side as well, we have our factory in Goa which is largely catering to export demand there, vacuum interrupters and so on, we raised vacuum interrupters and so on. They are definitely serving to a very large extent the export market.

items.statement: Cash from operations increased by Rs 1.3 billion to Rs 4.3 billion in H1 FY24 due to inventory optimization and cash collections
items.quote: Our focus on net working capital, especially inventory optimization and cash collections have paid off and we could increase our Cash from Operations vs. previous year by Rs. 1.3 billion to Rs. 4.3 billion.

items.statement: Energy market in India expected to grow at 9% CAGR till 2030; generation capacity to double to 820 GW by 2030
items.quote: In line with the fast-growing economy, the Energy Market in India is expected to grow at a CAGR of 9% till 2030. Generation capacity would almost double from the current 434 Gigawatt to 820 Gigawatt by 2030.

items.statement: Price enforcement contributed to Q2 EBITDA margin expansion of 240 bps
items.quote: Volume increase, a positive product and business mix and price enforcement have contributed to the margin expansion.

items.quote: It won an order from a leading oil exploration and production company to modernize and upgrade gas turbines. o It is executing an EPC substation construction project for a 400 KV gas insulated switchgear for a leading power producer and for a 220 KV gas insulated switchgear for a leading oil company o As part of an export order, it will be supplying a 400 KV gas insulated switchgear product for a

items.quote: The Government of India, taking cognizance of the increased energy demand resulting from this high rate of growth, has undertaken mega reforms in the form of the National Infrastructure Pipeline, Gati Shakti, Production-Linked Incentive Scheme, National Hydrogen Mission, COP 27 strategy and Transmission Plan 2030. All these measures will mean higher power generation and transmission capacity.

items.statement: Downside risks from escalation in geo-political tensions; order timing depends on customer decisions
items.quote: However, we cannot ignore the downside risks as a result of an escalation in geo-political tensions.

items.statement: Wolfgang Wrumnig took over as CFO effective March 1, 2024

items.statement: Siemens Xcelerator has 108 digital use cases and growing reference cases across market verticals
items.quote: As evidence of this success, we already have 108 digital use cases and are rapidly growing the number of reference cases across market verticals.

items.statement: Announced Rs 1,000 crore capex, the largest ever, to expand manufacturing for global supply chains
items.quote: the 1000 crores that we have announced in terms of CapEx, this is probably the largest CapEx announcement that we had ever made since I have been around

items.statement: Additional Rs 500 crore capex approved, taking total to nearly Rs 1,000 crore
items.quote: You are doing additional CapEx of about 500 crore rupees, taking the total CapEx to almost 1000 crore rupees

items.statement: Expanding Goa factory for GIS and Blue GIS driven by global export demand for sustainable products
items.quote: The investment that we are doing right now that we have announced today in the expansion of the facilities in Goa for GIS, one part of that is the Blue GIS and the driver for that is also export demand for Blue products globally

items.statement: Opening new metro factory to serve Indian market and global demand as part of global network
items.quote: On metros the fact that we are opening a factory right now basically demonstrates our view on the Indian market, but also the fact that we will use the fa ctory over here to start catering also to global demand

items.statement: Not at 100% capacity; existing capacity sufficient until new capacities come online
items.quote: We haven't waited until we have reached 100% capacity to start thinking about adding capacities. So we've got capacities that will beat our requirements for until the new capacities come into place

items.statement: Mobility bogie factory and Goa smart infrastructure factory predominantly serve export markets
items.quote: Our bogie factory on the mobility side is also doing predominantly export business. So, mobility is definitely very much a part of the global supply chains of Siemens

items.statement: Energy business exporting to multiple markets; expanding transmission exports as global capacity maxed out
items.quote: Already the energy business in India is already exporting to multiple markets as you said, and the intent is to expand that also further in the transmission space

items.statement: Order pipeline robust at same high level as prior year; spikes in energy transmission, e-vehicle, electrification
items.quote: overall the enquiry pipeline is robust. Has it gone up over the prior year? I would not say so. Is it at the same high level as in the prior year? Definitely

items.statement: C&S Electric export footprint growing substantially, ahead of acquisition plans
items.quote: Our footprint, our export footprint is growing substantially as planned, actually ahead of plans as well

items.statement: Digital industries slowdown due to channel destocking, not demand weakness; recovery expected Oct-Dec quarter

items.statement: Industrial drives demand robust but impacted by destocking; bounce back expected Oct-Dec quarter
items.quote: the demand is robust. We see that business growing. It may take some time before it completely bounces back from the destocking scenario. Our projection is in the October-December quarter

items.statement: C&S Electric margins at mid-teens EBITDA level sustainable driven by competitiveness improvements and revenue growth
items.quote: I believe in C&S Electric, we have done a lot to improve the competitiveness of the Company, which at the end of the day resulted in the mid teen margin corridor

items.quote: Last year saw significant positive impact on margin, which we didn't see this first half of the year. And on the other hand, we have a robust service business, which is value add and also supporting the development of our margin quality

items.statement: Mobility margins impacted by heavy rolling stock investments; expect return to double digits in couple of years as volumes ramp
items.quote: do expect, as the volumes start coming up, the margins will start improving as well. And I expect in a couple of years we will slowly get up to the same Siemens Limited – Analysts Call – 14th May 2024 29 levels that we were

items.statement: Focus on improving profitability through productivity measures; expect impact on margins going forward
items.quote: we have focused on improving our profitability and we will continue to do so. As I mentioned, there are, of course, different factors impacting the profitability. items.statement: Order mix balanced between short and long cycle, government and private orders
items.quote: On the order mix, again, it's a mixture of both short cycle and long cycle. It's a mixture also of government and private. So I think it's a good mix all round

items.statement: Competitive intensity increased substantially but normal for growing market; intent to remain market leader
items.quote: So, yes, as the market grows competition grows. And all our competitors are active, we are active as well and our intent is to continue being a market leader

items.statement: Siemens Energy AG is technology owner for energy business; all energy technologies will be available to Siemens Energy India
items.quote: Very clearly the energy business is driven by Siemens Energy AG, and the technology owner for the energy business is Siemens Energy AG, and therefore all the technologies in the energy space will be available to Siemens Energy India Limited here in India

items.statement: Demerger will create two promoter groups (Siemens AG and Siemens Energy); expect royalty/RPT terms to remain consistent
items.quote: I think you can expect consistency

items.statement: 9,000 HP locomotive project work started; revenue recognized continuously on PoC basis
items.quote: So, yes, work has started, very much started on the project overall. Revenue has started being booked. As I mentioned in one of my earlier meetings, this is a PoC project

items.statement: HVDC projects evaluated selectively based on technology, realization, payment terms, engineering resources; building local HVDC capabilities
items.quote: We are geared to do them, but we take them on a very selective basis, taking into account the technologies, the customer, the payment terms, the availability of resources, engineering resources, etc

items.statement: Employee expense down YoY due to productivity gains; specific details to be shared later
items.quote: There's definitely a productivity gain, but if you want specific answer, we can send that to you later

items.statement: Other income doubled due to gain on property sale and subsidiary dividend income
items.quote: One is the gain on sale of properties in this quarter for within Siemens Limited and the second topic is the dividend payment of our subsidiaries. We have booked this under other income

items.statement: HVDC bidding selective due to technology dependence on Siemens Energy AG, resource constraints, payment terms, and global vs local priority
items.quote: we examine them from a technology perspective, we examine them from a realization perspective. But we also need to acknowledge the HVDC market globally is booming. And therefore, we have got to look at it and along with the parent company, Siemens Energy AG, on whom we are dependent for technology

items.statement: No peak revenue guidance given for Rs 1,000 crore capex; only that investment hurdles are met
items.quote: I don't want to go out with numbers at this point in time but suffice to say that this means our hurdles, our investment hurdles in the Company and yeah, more than that I cannot say at this point in time

items.statement: Profitability improvement focus to continue; expect productivity measures to impact margins going forward
items.quote: we will continue to do so, and we expect that this will have impact on our margins going forward

items.quote: Our guidance was for 7 million tons. But looking at the ground impact on the elections tha t we have had and the ramp-up post-election has pushed us down from 7 million tons to 6.5 million tons

items.quote: for the full year we have generated volumes of ~ 5.51 mn mt, in line with our guidance of closing the year with volumes of 5.6 mn Mt.

items.statement: Target 50% green power in portfolio by FY30
items.quote: Our target is to have 50% green power in our portfolio by 2030.

items.quote: We believe that we should end up at a net debt position of somewhere around ₹1,275 crores to ₹1,300 crore with increased working capital requirement

items.quote: Out of ₹350 crore, I think ₹270- odd crore or ₹250 -odd crore is towards Andhra. And there is a ₹20 crore, ₹25 crore of Cape x per 6-megawatt solar plant at Gudipadu. The overall Cape x at Jeerabad as well as at Gudipadu approximately is ₹20 crores each

items.statement: Q4 plant utilisations: Mattampally 55%, Gudipadu 100%, Bayyavaram 77%, Jeerabad 82%, Jajpur 35%, Dachepalli 40%
items.quote: Mattampally plant operated at 55% utilization while Gudipadu, Bayyavaram, Jeerabad, Jajpur and Dachepalli plants operated at 100%, 77%, 82%, 35% and 40%, respectively, during the quarter.

items.statement: Q1 FY25 volumes expected 15-20% lower YoY due to elections; H2 FY25 strong pickup expected
items.quote: Q1 definitely is going to be 15% to 20% lower, probably Q2 is the time when we believe that it should start ramping up.

items.statement: FY25 market growth in operating regions expected at 6-7.5% similar to FY24
items.quote: the average market growth in the regions that we operate ranged anywhere between 5% to 10%. On an average, it is anywhere between 6% to 7.5%. It's the same guidance for FY '25 is what we are giving.

items.statement: Q4 EBITDA margin 10% vs 6% YoY and 13% QoQ; muted realisations limited margin expansion
items.quote: Margins for the quarter stood at 10% as agains t 6% in Q4FY23 and 13% in previous quarter. Margins for the quarter could have been even higher but for the muted realisations mentioned earlier

items.statement: Expect margin trajectory and EBITDA/ton improvement to sustain on cost rationalisation and green energy
items.quote: We expect the margin trajectory and EBITDA/ton improvement to sustain going forward as well on the back of our investment towards cost rationalization and commitment towards increasing the share of green energy in the overall mix.

items.statement: Current prices Rs 5-10 per bag lower than March exit; Q4 average likely Rs 10-15 lower
items.quote: Current prices are ₹5 to ₹10 lower than the Q4 prices. March exit to now, the prices in the markets that we operate are anywhere between ₹5 to ₹10 per bag lower

items.quote: the only thing that we belie ve, which is in our control is, we believe costs are likely to come down by ₹100 for us per ton from Q4 to current

items.quote: it is around close to 800 Kcal per kg of clinker. The target is to be close to 700.

items.quote: with the ramp-up of Andhra and all, it is obvious that we would definitely need increased working capital as a policy in the past, we used to keep six months of fuel inventory, so we would want to go back to that.

items.statement: Gross debt Rs 1,439 crore (long-term Rs 1,248 crore) as of Mar 2024; debt-equity 0.62x; cash Rs 262 crore
items.quote: the gross debt as on 31st March 2024 stood at Rs 1,439 crores out of which Rs 1,248 crores as a long-term debt and the remaining constitutes the working capital. items.statement: Outstanding incentives ~Rs 150 crore across Telangana, Andhra, Odisha unpaid for 10 years; timing uncertain
items.quote: Around ₹150-odd crore of it got accumulated. But we did not receive for last 10 years. So, I don't know when we will receive. These have been du e across few states, that is both Telangana, Andhra and Odisha

items.statement: Vizag land sale targeted for completion by end FY25
items.quote: we are more than hopeful by end of this financial year, I think we should c onclude at the Vizag land sale

items.statement: Trade cement share target 60% by end FY26 from current ~52%
items.quote: Our target is from current 52-odd percent, we want to reach to 60% by end of FY '26.

items.statement: New capacities ramping in Nalgonda/Yerraguntla clusters: Ramco, Shree, Deccan, Chettinad, My Home, UltraTech Tadipatri
items.quote: Ramco, Kolimigundla, I think, they are good close to a year now, but I think ramping up is almost complete for them. Shree commissioned, I think they are in a stage to ramp up. We are expecting Deccan to com mission any time soon

items.statement: Government demand vaporised in Q4 FY24 through Q2 FY25 in AP/Telangana; restart only in H2 FY25
items.quote: Government demand got vapori sed for last Q4 all the way up to Q1 , and I think that would be the situation even till the end of Q2 for the current year. The restart for the government demand would only happen in the second half of this year

items.statement: No equity raise planned at parent level; any raise only for compliance not necessity
items.quote: regarding the equity raise, the requirement for equity raise is more from a compliance perspective, but not from the necessity perspective. I don't think we have any plans to raise equity at the parent com pany even

items.statement: Non-trade volumes not compromising realisations; trade vs non-trade realisation difference negligible
items.quote: the realisation difference between trade and non-trade is negligible. It's not that the non-trade would be contributing to a lesser realisation.

items.statement: Andhra Cement EBITDA breakeven expected by end Q1 FY26
items.quote: We are hopeful that it should have been in the current financial year. We should do the same thing by Q1, same time next year end of Q1 next year, we believe that we should reach to that point.

items.statement: Revenue growth guidance of 18% for FY25, with ~16% from brand sales and ~2% from Dahej technical sales
items.quote: The revenue forecast given of 18%, around 16% is from the brand sales and about 2% is some technical sales from Dahej and the number includes both the businesses.

items.statement: EBITDA margin guidance of ~18% for FY25, with gross margin expected at 38%
items.quote: You see we are of the opinion 38% gross margin appears to be sustainable. As against 39%, we are expecting 39% -- 38% gross margin because of which we are expecting EBITDA at around 18% this year.

items.statement: Volume growth expected at 15% for FY25 vs 9.07% in FY24
items.quote: And with La Nifia, we are expecting the volume growth to be in the range of 15

items.statement: Dahej plant incremental revenue target of INR40 crores for FY25
items.quote: It's around INR40 crores incremental?

items.quote: Yes, Mr. Hussain. This FY '25, we are planning further capex for a new herbicide plant, and it will come in H2.

items.statement: Gross margin expanded ~400 bps in FY24; ~100-150 bps from low-cost inventory, ~300 bps from product mix
