items.quote: The prices, especially Paracetamol prices reduced by more than 35 % to 40% during the year. Similarly, prices of Metformin also reduced by 20%-22% during the financial year. Even Ethyl Acetate prices were down by around 10%.

items.statement: Ibuprofen prices stable at $10-11 range
items.quote: The prices has ranged between $10 to $11.

items.statement: Specialty chemical margin hit by Chinese player volatility in alcohol and acetic acid raw material prices
items.quote: There was a mismatch between input prices and the final price of chemicals, especially Ethyl Acetate. The volatility by the Chinese player in the raw material of this alcohol and Acetic Acid was there, which impacted the mismatch.

items.statement: ANVISA approval for all 10 plants enables Brazilian market access for non-ibuprofen products
items.quote: ANVISA approved all our 10 plants, though all are located in the single location. Existing revenue is coming from all these product plants. The difference is that now all these products also got approved by ANVISA, Brazil. With this, we will now be able to explore the Brazilian market for these non-ibuprofen products

items.statement: Other expenses rose due to higher freight and insurance costs from Red Sea crisis
items.quote: Due to the Red Sea crisis, the prices of the freight has been increased substantially along with the insurance cost for our exports and import s both. That resulted in increased expenses and the redistribution costs, ultimately leading to rise in combined other expenses.

items.statement: Non-ibuprofen contribution at ~40% of API portfolio in FY24
items.quote: Non-ibuprofen contribution for this financial year is around 40% of the API portfolio.

items.statement: Gabapentin project converted to multi-product plant, will produce on campaign basis only
items.quote: As regard to Gabapentin, we have already informed to the stock exchanges that management has decided to change that project into the multi -product plant and for Gabapentin we will produce only on the campaign-based basis and will not have a dedicated plant.

items.statement: Sitagliptin developed and validated with Indian patent approval, launch not planned for FY25
items.quote: We have developed the Sitagliptin in our R&D. It is already validated and approved by Indian Patent. But as of now, we have not planned for the exact date of launch. It may not be in the current financial year.

items.statement: Expects robust double-digit growth in ATBS sales in FY25
items.quote: We anticipate the demand for ATBS remaining strong and this should lead to a robust double digit growth in ATBS sales in the next fiscal financial year.

items.statement: Expects revenue CAGR of approximately 20% over next 3 years
items.quote: We expect to have maintain a revenue CAGR of approximately 20% over the next 3 years mainly driven by the new products as well as some of our existing products.

items.statement: Expects FY25 revenue at least 20-25% higher than FY24
items.quote: I am seeing a sequential growth of, I don't know, 23% or 30% in PAT. And I expect FY’25 to be at least 20%, 25% higher than FY'24.

items.statement: Expects to maintain EBITDA margins in range of 26% for FY25
items.quote: I expect to maintain or to see EBITDA margins in the range of 26% because this is how the product mix is goi ng to stay going forward

items.statement: FY24 capex was about INR360 crores across VOPL and Vinati Organics
items.quote: This financial year, we did a capex of about INR360 crores some of it in our subsidiary VOPL and some in Viniti Organics itself expanding capacity as we ll as adding some new products

items.statement: Total VOPL capex approximately INR500 crores for anisole, MEHQ Guaiacol, 4'-Methoxyacetophenone and isoamylene derivatives
items.quote: The total capex in VOPL will be approximately INR500 crores, mainly consisting of anisole, MEHQ Guaiacol, 4'-Methoxyacetophenone and a couple of isoamylene derivatives.

items.statement: Overall capex in FY25 should be around INR550 crores including subsidiary
items.quote: The overall capex in the coming fin ancial year should be around INR 550 crores including the subsidiary

items.statement: MEHQ Guaiacol plant commissioned in March, revenue contribution expected from H2 FY25
items.quote: One plant in this product portfolio making MEHQ Guaiacol was commissioned in March. Howev er, since it is recently commissioned we are still working on getting our product tested and sampled with customers as well as we are working on enhancing the yield and efficiency of the plant. We expect revenue contributions of any significance really only coming from the second half of financial year 2025

items.statement: Anisole, 4-methoxyacetophenone, tertiary amyl alcohol, para tertiary amylphenol to be commissioned in H2 FY25
items.quote: We also expect the other products, the anisole, 4 -methoxyacetophenone, tertiary amyl alcohol as well as para tertiary amylphenol to be commissioned in the second half of this financial year.

items.statement: ATBS expansion expected to be completed in H2 FY25
items.quote: Similarly, the ATBS expansion is expected to be completed somewhere in the second half of financial year 2025.

items.statement: Butyl phenols capacity utilization at 65-70% in FY24, close to 100% in Q4 FY24
items.quote: In FY24, we were at about 65% 70% capacity utilization in butylphenols. We are already seeing it close to 100 this quarter.

items.statement: ATBS running at close to 100% utilization on existing capacity due to high purity demand
items.quote: Today, obviously, we are ru nning, again, it depends on the quality mix of ATBS, which is in demand. Today, we are seeing good demand for the higher purity ATBS. When that is in demand, then you can produce less. There is capacity constraint. Now, given that, we are close to 100% utilization

items.statement: New ATBS line will take at least 3 years to achieve full capacity utilization
items.quote: Now, after the new line comes in place, again, it will take at least three years for it to achieve that full capacity utilization.

items.statement: VOPL sales expected to double to INR280-300 crores in FY25 from INR130 crores in FY24
items.quote: See, one can expect sales to double, at least double. I mean, we did INR130 crores. I think we should do close to INR280 crores, INR300 crores this financial year.

items.statement: Veeral Organics (VOPL) meaningful sales only from FY26, FY25 maybe INR50 crores
items.quote: Veeral Organics, I don't think see I don't think you can take meaningful sales this year. Maybe I have sales of is this correct In FY25 maybe INR100 crores not even 100. INR50 crores they are saying because the other products will get commercia lized only by December, January

items.statement: ATBS demand normalized, destocking over, seeing recovery in Q4
items.quote: During this fiscal year while overall in the year ATBS sales were down compared to last year, but however as mentioned in the previous earnings call ATBS s ales have now normalized. The destocking is over and as you can see in the results of Q4 we are seeing a recovery

items.statement: Antioxidant demand still weak but expects significant scaling in FY25
items.quote: Even though the demand for AO is still going through a weak period, we anticipate scaling up our AO sales quite significantly in FY25 and we expect it to be a growth driver for the company.

items.statement: Butyl phenols saw good growth in FY24, expects continued growth in FY25
items.quote: Butyl phenols has been a revenue contributor this year. The sales were approximately INR300 crores coming from this segment. We saw good growth and we expect this business to continue delivering growth in the next financial year as well.

items.statement: ATBS contributed ~32% of revenue in FY24, similar in Q4
items.quote: ATBS overall this financial year contributed about 32%. Even in Q4 it was similar because even butyl phenols and antioxidants have contributed to the revenue.

items.statement: Customized products basket (IBB, niche products) revenue ~INR150 crores, doubled over 4 years, expects steady EBITDA
items.quote: Over the last four years, this basket of products has doubled in revenue to about INR 150 crores and we expect good growth in the coming years as well.

items.statement: Antioxidant revenue ~INR130 crores in FY24, long-term outlook positive
items.quote: the revenue in t his financial year was about INR 130 crores. The value synergies are growing from a doubly backward integrated plant and our efforts have led to our presence being felt in the domestic as well as the export market in this segment

items.statement: Butyl phenol price improvement due to anti-dumping duty imposed
items.quote: Yes, actually there has been a price improvement in butyl phenol. We were able to get an anti-dumping duty imposed and that can potentially change the revenue potential but also you have to keep in mind that price fluctuates based on the input raw material prices.

items.statement: Antioxidant prices eroded in last year due to Chinese imports
items.quote: Also, in antioxidants, we have seen a price erosion in the last year or so. There is a lot of product coming in from China and places like that.

items.statement: No market share lost in any product; China not a major threat except in antioxidants where domestic demand and backward integration provide competitiveness
items.quote: See, whether it was last year, whether it is this year, we haven't lost market share in any of our products. So, I don't, if anyone's adding capacity, not adding capacity, maybe they're not able to produce the right quality. Maybe they're not able to sell. I'm not really sure. Again, the only real product where they're facing competition from China is in antioxidants. But there is a good domestic

items.statement: ATBS global market share unchanged at 60-65%
items.quote: Our global market share also in ATBS remains unchanged at 60% to 65%.

items.statement: Antioxidant peak potential INR700 crores, expects 50% capacity utilization in FY25 from 25% in FY24
items.quote: The potential is still INR700 crores. See, last year, we were at about 25% capacity utilization. Since the market in plas tics is still slow, I'm expecting to do at least 50% utilization this year

items.statement: Butyl phenols + antioxidants combined peak potential ~INR1000 crores
items.quote: So, combined together, butyl phenols as well as antioxidants, still the potential is about INR1000 crores.

items.statement: Commissioned ~33 MW solar power, reduces emissions and conventional energy dependence
items.quote: As of today, we have commissioned total approximat ely 33 megawatts in solar power which helps us in reducing emissions as well as reduces our dependence on conventional sources

items.statement: ATBS new line delayed due to equipment delivery constraints from Europe, realistic start December or January
items.quote: The demand is looking strong and we want to commission our new line as soon as possible, b ut due to delivery constraints of some of the equipment that we have ordered from Europe the plant I do not think will start before December or January. That is what realistically it is looking like

items.statement: AUM aspiration of up to Rs. 1,450 crores for FY25
items.quote: Finally, our outlook for the coming year remains robust with an AUM aspiration of up to Rs. 1,450 crores for FY25.

items.statement: Target AUM mix of 55:45 SME retail to wholesale in coming years
items.quote: Further, we aim to achieve an AUM mix of 55 to 45 SME retail to wholesale in the coming years.

items.statement: Expect ROE to improve to 15-16% range over next 2 years
items.quote: As we s cale up in the coming 2 years, we expect our ROEs to improve further and be in the range of 15% to 16% which has already started to happen on a quarterly basis as of Q4

items.statement: Plan to increase branch count by 50% in FY25 and double network in next two years
items.quote: Subject to market conditions, we are looking to add significantly more branches in FY24. We will increase our branch count by 50% in FY25 and look to double the branch network in the next two years.

items.statement: AUM grew 9% QoQ and 38% YoY to Rs. 1,030 crore in FY24
items.quote: Our AUM has shown robust growth of 9% quarter-on-quarter and 38% year-on-year, reaching a total of Rs. 1,030 crore of an AUM.

items.statement: Loan book reached Rs. 926 crore as on FY24
items.quote: Subsequently, our loan book has reached Rs. 926 crores as on Financial Year '24.

items.statement: Cumulative disbursements of Rs. 1,052 crore in FY24, up 39% YoY
items.quote: We have made cumulative disbursements of a total of Rs. 1,052 crores in FY24 registering a 39% growth over the previous year.

items.statement: Off-book AUM accumulated at Rs. 104 crore, expected to increase in coming year
items.quote: So far we have accumulated a total of Rs. 104 crores off-book AUM and we expect this to increase recently in the coming year.

items.statement: GNPA and NNPA improved by 17 bps and 10 bps respectively over previous year
items.quote: Now, we come to our asset quality, which has remained robust with a further improvement in GNPA and NNPA, which stood lowered by 17 bps a nd 10 bps respectively over the previous financial

items.statement: Maintaining 1% provision on loan book vs 0.4% regulatory requirement with 270% PCR
items.quote: Further, we are prudently provisioning a flat 1% of our loan book as opposed to the regulatory requirement of 0.4%. We are following a conservative accounting policy and are maintaining a provision coverage ratio of 270%.

items.statement: Recovered Rs. 2.34 crore from earlier write-offs in FY24
items.quote: Furthermore, we have also witnessed decent tractions on the recovery front. In FY24, we have recovered a sum total of Rs. 2.34 crores from our earlier write off.

items.statement: Net interest income up 38% YoY to Rs. 120 crore in FY24
items.quote: For the full financial year, our net interest income is up by 38%, reaching Rs. 120 crores and a net profit for FY24 stood at Rs. 63 crores, registering significant growth of 39% over FY23.

items.statement: Q4 NII decreased 4% QoQ due to higher liquidity and negative carry
items.quote: Despite a 3% quarter-on-quarter growth in total income for quarter 4, we experienced a 4% decrease in net interest income in Q4 due to higher liquidity and negative interest carry on the same.

items.statement: Expect NIM improvement of 0.25-0.30% in first year from rating upgrade benefit
items.quote: I would say whatever what can be the benefit cost of borrowi ng can go down by 56 to 75 base, so it is only the incremental cost I would say in terms of NIMS 0.25% to 0.3% can be the net addition in the first year

items.statement: Incremental borrowing cost expected to reduce 50-75 bps from PSU banks post rating upgrade
items.quote: And definitely the cost of borrowing will come down over a period of time. The incremental cost will come down from all lenders and specifically from the PSU front, maybe in the range of initially 50 bps to 75 bps initially.

items.statement: Leverage ratio comfortable at ~1.0x debt-to-equity, scope to increase to ~2.5x over next two years
items.quote: Additionally, our leverage ratio is very comfortab le right now and there is decent scope to leverage our books from existing ~1.0 debt to equity to ~2.5 times over the coming two years

items.statement: Added DCB Bank and Indian Overseas Bank as lending partners in Q4, total lenders now 23 vs 15 in FY23
items.quote: We are pleased to announce that we have added two new lending partners this quarter, DCB Bank and Indian Overseas Bank in the quarter 4 and our total lending partners at the end of the year stands at a total of 23, which was earlier in FY23 it was a total of 15 lenders.

items.statement: Credit rating upgraded to A- from BBB+ by Acuite Ratings & Research
items.quote: Another crucial update from last quarter has been the credit rating upgrade to A - table from Acuite Ratings & Research. We surged from erstwhile BBB+.

items.statement: Board recommended dividend of Rs. 2.5 per equity share for FY24
items.quote: Given our healthy and profitable growth, I am pleased to announce that the board has recommended a dividend of Rs. 2.5 per equity share.

items.statement: Employee count increased to 421 in FY24 from 257 in FY23, driven by branch strengthening and Suvidha division
items.quote: We have seen a significant jump in the number of team members from 421 people by the end of FY24 compared to 257 which were there last year and we had just added 3 branches last year.

items.statement: Employee cost growth expected to be 20-25% in FY25 vs 30-40% previously
items.quote: I would say now we are in the middle of appraisal also. Appraisal will also add some portion of the cost and I wouldn't say that this 30% ris e because now we only require people at the branch. We don't require people at the middle level, at the regional level or at the HO level. So, the cost, I think, should not go beyond 20% to 25% in this financial year

items.statement: SME retail to wholesale AUM mix shifted to 44:56 in FY24, a 4% shift toward SME retail
items.quote: Currently, the SME retail and the wholesale AUM mix stands at 44 to 56 in FY24 wherein we have seen a shift of 4% in the favor of SME retail over FY23.

items.statement: Suvidha loan product re-engineering underway, relaunch expected in Q2 FY25 on new digital platform
items.quote: However, we are in the final stages of concluding this task and expect the rollout to happen in quarter 2 of the new financial year.

items.statement: Fee income grew from Rs. 5 crore to Rs. 9.5 crore YoY driven by DA spreads (6-7% retail, 1.5-2% wholesale) and co-lending fees
items.quote: Definitely, we are doing, one is the retail part when we are doing retail. So, typically our IRR, we have done lending at around 18% and the DA is happening between 10% and 11%. So, we are getting a spread of 6% to 7% on the retail, yes, it is without any kind of recourse, but at the same time we are very cautious and that it will only grow if the quality of o ur book which we are down selling is

items.quote: Lastly I would also say in the last 2 months -3 months there has been a lot of I would say f rom the regulators and the banks regarding unsecured, so even on lenders sometimes used to ask especially what kind of unsecured book you are having. So, right now, so very frankly, an unsecured book is not being seen very positively by any of the lenders or rating agencies

items.statement: Suvidha product targets 10-15% penetration of 150,000 fabricators, potential Rs. 150-200 crore AUM in 2-3 years
items.quote: We are able to penetrate 10% to 15% in the next two years, three years, roughly AUM of around Rs. 150-Rs. 200 crores if our ticket size remains 1 lakh to 1.5 lakh.

items.statement: Suvidha platform development cost roughly Rs. 30-50 lakhs plus ongoing AMC and enhancements
items.quote: It will be roughly between Rs. 30 lakhs to Rs. 50 lakhs and then their A&C and enhancement costs keep on happening at every time.

items.statement: Eigen Engineering targets 20-25% CAGR for several years, aiming to grow from INR100 crores to INR500 crores over the next couple of years
items.quote: And we believe that it should be possible to maintain this kind of growth in the 20% to 25% range on a CAGR basis for several years to come.

items.statement: Packaging segment expected to grow to INR80-100 crores over 5-7 years with new facility near Chandigarh
items.quote: With this new facility and the opening up of some new market segments that we are working on, we believe that the Packaging segment will continue to show very handsome growth and develop into a INR80 crores to INR100 crores business over the next 5 to 7 years.

items.statement: KDDL manufacturing units spent INR39 crores on capex in FY24; expects INR45 crores capex in FY25 for all businesses
items.quote: During the year, KDDL manufacturing units spent almost INR39 crores on the capital expenditure. This excludes the capital expenditure by Ethos for the growth of the business. And during the current running year, the KDDL expects capex of around INR45 crores for all our businesses.

items.statement: New Bangalore bracelet plant inaugurated with 75,000 bracelets/year capacity at INR35 crores investment; commercial production starting soon
items.quote: We have spent approximately INR35 crores to establish this plant with a capacity of 75,000 in bracelets per year. The trial production and supplies have been made and received very well and commercial production will start very soon.

items.statement: Eigen Engineering expanding factory space with new construction and machines over next couple of years to serve strong order book
items.quote: This year already, there is a planned expansion of space. This is planned in the same premises we already have, but we will be expanding the factory space with new construction and machines. And this expansion program is actually we have planned something over the next couple of years because it will have to be a continuous expansion as the demand increases.

items.statement: New packaging facility near Chandigarh with 1 million boxes capacity at estimated INR8 crores cost
items.quote: For this segment, we are establishing a new facility near Chandigarh with a capacity of 1 million boxes at an estimated cost of INR8 crores.

items.statement: Watch component export demand slowing due to market correction in China, Europe, Middle East and geopolitical strains
items.quote: The geopolitical strains in Europe and Middle East, the uncertainty in USA and sluggish Chinese demand predict a subdued consumer sentiment for all discretionary products, including watches over the next few months in these important global markets.

items.statement: Eigen Engineering order book very strong with diverse export clients and strong RFQs for new products
items.quote: As I mentioned in my speech, the Eigen order book is very strong. We have diverse clients, market segments, especially in the export or deemed export segment. And the order book for existing products as well as new products. And RFQs for new products is strong

items.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin 19.5% in FY24; standalone EBITDA margin 28.5% in FY24
items.quote: EBITDA for the year grew by 53% year-on-year to INR270 crores and EBITDA margin stood at 19.5%.

items.statement: Precision engineering margins lower than watch components currently but expected to increase with more specialized products
items.quote: The margins in precision engineering components are also very good, but lower than the watch component for the moment. For the time being that is the case. So we may have a slight decrease in overall margin because the shift of the -- the precision engineering business will grow faster than the watch components business in this year.

items.statement: Eigen Engineering focuses on electronics, aerospace, alternative energy and EVs comprising 80% of business; alternative energy and EVs expected to grow fastest
items.quote: EIGEN is our segments for the precision stamping company we make: electronics, aerospace, alternative energy and electrical vehicles. These are the segments that comprise 80% of our business that are growing fast and we will continue to focus on these businesses.

items.statement: Plans to enter watch case manufacturing in FY26 leveraging steel capabilities from bracelet project
items.quote: And we believe, definitely not in FY '25, but probably in FY '26, we will move towards setting up, getting into the watch cases. It is definitely part of our strategy.

items.statement: Eigen Engineering serves diverse marquee export clients with >70% export share; watch components 70-75% export
items.quote: Revenue growth is attributable to the higher share of exports, which is more than 70% of the total revenue.

items.quote: This also means that it's a business is a very large more. It has to be done in Switzerland f

items.statement: Watch components 70-75% export; Eigen Engineering >70% export; bracelet plant 100% export to Swiss/European markets
items.quote: I think about 70% to 75% is export.

items.statement: KDDL sold Ethos stake for INR193 crores (INR122 crores direct sale + INR72 crores dividend from Mahen Distribution); cash used for shareholder rewards and growth
items.quote: Recently, KDDL sold a stake in Ethos Limited. We received approximately INR193 crores from this stake sale, which includes about INR122 crores from the direct stake sale and INR72 crores as dividend income from Mahen Distribution Limited, which also sold some shares of Ethos as well.

items.statement: Final dividend INR4 per share announced (subject to AGM approval) plus INR58 interim dividend paid in Jan'24; INR100 crores investable surplus for growth and shareholder rewards
items.quote: During the year, in the last Board meeting yesterday, the KDDL has announced a final dividend of INR4 per equity share. This is subject to the approval of the shareholders at the Annual General Meeting. And this is in addition to the interim dividend of INR58 per share paid in January '24.

items.statement: Michel Pauli joined as new MD of Estima AG; leadership team changes made to improve capacity utilization and technical capabilities
items.quote: We are happy to announce that Mr. Michel Pauli, a very experienced technology and business leader has joined as the new Managing Director of Estima. In addition, we have made several chan ges in the operating and leadership team at Estima.

items.statement: Impairment loss taken on Estima via Kamla International Holdings and Pylania SA due to continuous losses
items.quote: Due to continuous losses in Estima, we have made a provision by impairing the value of investment in these entities in our financials.

items.statement: Estima turnaround delayed by ~1 year due to unexpected slowing in Swiss watch business
items.quote: But, because of the unexpected slowing down in the Swiss watch business, this turnaround will probably be delayed by about a year.

items.statement: Silvercity Brands global launch of Favre-Leuba scheduled for last quarter of current year; brand establishment expected to take 3-5 years
items.quote: This current increase in the capital of Silvercity Brand s is essentially for the requirements of working capital and to be able to launch the brand globally, which is scheduled to be done in the last quarter of this year.

items.statement: KDDL maintains ~54% stake in Ethos; committed to majority ownership but further stake sales possible
items.quote: KDDL and my input together, we currently have about 54% of Ethos. It is our articulated thing that our position that KDDL will continue to maintain a majority stake in Ethos, there is no question. Whether there will be some more stake sale, we cannot say right now. But we will continue to maintain majority.

items.statement: Management prefers factory visits over frequent calls; plans 2-3 factory visit events per year for serious analysts
items.quote: We would like to organize at least twice a year, maybe more visits to our factories, where we have a full day of discussion analysis after you have seen the factory, you've got a feel for what is our business.

items.statement: FY2024 was an elevated and peak capex year; clear moderation expected in FY2025
items.quote: We have always mentioned that FY2024 will be an elevated and peak level of capex and I expect to see clear moderation going into FY2025.

items.statement: Wireless capex to moderate meaningfully in FY2025; transport, enterprise, data center, and homes capex to continue
items.quote: I think where the moderation will happen is really on wireless capex which accounts by the way for a large part of the capex so to that extent we do see moderation going ahead into next year.

items.statement: B2B capex had one-off fiber and data center spends in Q4; submarine cable investments are lumpy
items.quote: our B2B business had a bit of one -off this quarter which is primarily related to fiberi zation so we bought some fibers and some spends o n the data center business

items.statement: Rolled out ~43,100 network sites and ~55,982 km of fiber in FY2024; 5G available nationwide
items.quote: We rolled out about 43,100 network sites and 55,982 kilometers of fiber. Our bet on NSA which is a non-standalone technology paid off it just not only saved us capex it also delivered superior experience.

items.statement: Plan to roll out over 25,000 rural sites in next couple of quarters, lower than last year
items.quote: We have commenced another round of expan sion here to plug this gap. We expect to rollout over 25000 sites lower than last year in the next couple of quarters

items.statement: Industry customer additions in low single digits annually over last 12 quarters
items.quote: You are seei ng that customer addition in the low single digits at the aggregate level

items.statement: India RoCE 9.5% in FY2024, extremely low; tariff repair needed to improve returns
items.quote: Our RoCE for India is 9.5%, which is extremely low for a business that is so essential to the digital spine of this country. Clearly tariff repair is needed to set this right.

items.statement: Tariff repair essential; current ARPU ~Rs 209, right level ~Rs 300; industry needs substantial repair
items.quote: We are already at just over Rs. 200 ARPU. I think the right level of ARPU even at Rs. 300 would still be one of the lowest in the world so there is substantial repair to be had in the industry.

items.statement: Tariff hikes will occur in multiple rounds, not one shot; SIM consolidation modest; digital essentiality supports absorption
items.quote: Obviously it will not go in one shot from 200 to 300 that is not going to happen but it will have a couple of rounds to actually get there.

items.statement: 5G base ~72 million as of March 2024, growing 2-2.5M/month; free 5G doubles data usage vs 4G
items.quote: We have roughly 72 million 5G customers as of March 2024. This is growing currently at the rate of 2 to 2.5 million every month.

items.statement: DTH customer base grew 9,000 in Q4 and 200,000+ in FY2024, only operator to grow; moderate price hike due to broadcaster increases
items.quote: On an annual basis after two years of decline we grew our customer base by over 200,000 net adds the only operator in the industry to grow customers during this year.

items.statement: Mobile churn reduced from 2.9% in Q3 to 2.4% in Q4 via structural grid-based experience program
items.quote: This was also supported by our structural efforts to fix the network experience which saw mobile churn reducing from 2.9% in Q3 to 2.4% in Q4.

items.statement: Welcome VI fundraising; three strong private operators good for India; market remains brutally competitive
items.quote: I am glad to see that VI has raised money a nd I really wish them well. I think India will be we ll served if it has three good private operators working there

items.statement: Rights issue guidance of three years has 6-8 months left; formal revised guidance expected in 3-5 months
items.quote: Our understanding is more a guidance and we will have to chew on what is the outlook for the free cash flows so maybe by the next three to five months we will come out with a more formal either a revised guidance or whatever commentary that we have to provide.

items.statement: India net debt/EBITDA at 2.86x; paid Rs 16,350 Cr debt in FY2024; expect further reduction
items.quote: India net debt to EBITDA is n ow at a comfortable level of 2.86. We expect further debt reduction going forward

items.statement: Bharti Hexacom repaid Rs 1,500 Cr in Q4; net debt/EBITDA 2.14x at year-end
items.quote: I am happy to report we have repaid about Rs. 1500 Crores of debt in Q4 and ended the year with a net debt to EBITDA of about 2.14.

items.statement: Bharti Hexacom IPO completed; investor confidence reflects brand, execution, integrity, governance
items.quote: I want to start by th anking our investors for showing confidence in us through the recently concluded Bharti Hexacom IPO. This speaks well about the brand Airtel, about our execution capabilities, high standards of integrity and corporate governance

items.statement: Dividend policy premature; combination of deleveraging and dividend as cash generation improves
items.quote: Obviously as we generate more cash a combination of deleveraging and dividend will happen. I think it is too premature for us to comment on any dividend policy.

items.statement: All 20,000 employees spent a day with frontline staff in March; ongoing ritual to improve experience
items.quote: We think of Airtel as having only two types of people those who serve customers and those who serve those who serve customers. It is with this in mind that we had every one of our 20,000 people get out into the market and spend a whole day with our frontline people in March.

items.statement: Airtel Business domestic revenue growing 18-20% annually; global wholesale business under pressure from OTT cutbacks
items.quote: The domestic business is on a strong footing and continues to grow at 18 to 20%.

items.statement: Payments Bank MTU 67M; annualized revenue run rate >Rs 2,100 Cr; deposits ~Rs 2,800 Cr, up ~50% YoY
items.value: 67M MTU; Rs 2,100 Cr revenue run rate
items.quote: Monthly transacting users under 67 million. The annualized revenue run rate is now over 2100 Crores; deposits remain robust at around 2,800 Crores growing nearly 50% year-on-year.

items.statement: Management expects new products to contribute 7-10% of FY25 revenue
items.quote: Going forward, we are looking for new products to contribute about 7% to 10% if everything goes well up next year's revenues.

items.statement: Management targets formulation revenue share of around 70% in FY25
items.quote: We are looking at around 70% moving forward. It could be a little more too, but we will see as we go.

items.statement: Management expects EBITDA margin of 22-23% in FY25
items.quote: I would be very conservatively say something around 22%, 23% is possible. That's what we have been maintaining throughout, and we are trying for more, but let's see what happens.

items.statement: Management targets net debt to EBITDA ratio of 1 to 1.1x over next 2-3 years
items.quote: So internally, we want to manage net debt to EBITDA at 1 to 1.1 level, 1.1, we are comfortable.

items.statement: Management estimates FY25 capex of INR6,000 million
items.quote: FY25 capex, we are estimating about 6,000 million, INR600 crores. So, half of that will be granules lifesciences expansion, other half will be for other projects as well as maintenance capital.

items.statement: New formulation facility at Genome Valley commenced operations in March 2024, adding 8 billion dosages capacity
items.quote: The construction and capacity ramp -up of the new formulation facility at Genome Valley as part of Granules Life Sciences is progressing well. This plant will add 8 billion dosages to our finished dosage capacity. The plant successfully commenced operations in the month of March, and the capacity is being ramped up progressively.

items.statement: Formulation capacity ramp-up to reach 100 million dosages per month by August 2024 and 4-5 billion annualized by April-May 2025
items.quote: Assuming it's that, I think in July the ramp up will happen. By August we should be touching about something like 100 million per month and over the next eight months from then, maybe into April, May of next fiscal, we should be able to touch at least 4 to 5 billion annualized capacity.

items.statement: Gross margin (value added) improved to 55.1% in FY24 from 48.9% in FY23, with Q4 FY24 at 60.1%
items.quote: Our value added as a percentage of sales for FY '24 was 55.1% as compared to 48.9% in FY '23. Value added as compared to FY '23 is up by 6.3% primarily on account of higher FDs including GPI manufactured products and lower material costs.

items.statement: Management expects gross margin sustainability in 55-58% range for FY25
items.quote: So depending on the raw material costs and our product mix we see the sustainability in the range of 55% to 58%.

items.statement: 16-18 product launches planned for FY25 across US and Europe, with 14 new products
items.quote: And just to add to that, we have a total of about 16 to 18 launches coming up this fiscal year, out of which 14 products will be new and remaining will be essential extensions of the launches -- ramp-up of the launches that we've already made in Q4.

items.statement: Demand for all products is healthy except paracetamol which faces challenges from overstocking and excess capacity
items.quote: The demand for all our products is quite good. As we add new ge ography, the sales are also increasing. And there is a fairly good demand, a very healthy demand for all our products. Except, of course, with the exception of paracetamol, where we have had some challenges in the last quarter.

items.statement: Paracetamol API prices dropped from INR600-650 to INR250-300 due to overstocking and excess post-COVID capacity
items.quote: the prices have come down from something like INR600, INR650 to INR250 or INR300, it was lower than that. So, that is what has contributed to the decline in sales in this region.

items.statement: Paracetamol price erosion expected to stabilize from Q3 FY25, with full normalization by FY26
items.quote: I think this year most of this thing may continue. Next year onwards, FY '26, things should stabilize. But even during this year, quarter-on-quarter, I think there will be some improvement.

items.statement: Finished dosage share increased to 65% of FY24 revenue from 50% in FY23, new products (ex-legacy 5) now 25% of revenue vs 15% a year ago
items.quote: Our FD segment has grown by 41% in Q4 FY '24 compared to Q4 FY '23 and contributed 65% of our revenue in FY '24. The sales of new products other than our legacy five products have been growing well and now contributes 25% of our revenue versus 15% one year ago.

items.statement: FY24 capex of INR3,823 million primarily invested in Granules Life Sciences (INR1,560 million) and Granules CZRO (INR565 million)
items.quote: During the year we spent INR 3,823 million primarily invested in Granules Life Science amounted to INR1,560 million and Granules CZRO INR565 million.

items.statement: Cash-to-cash cycle increased to 161 days in Q4 FY24 from 132 days at start of year due to new launches and Red Sea issues
items.quote: Our cash-to-cash cycle was 161 days in the current quarter as compared to 132 days at the beginning of the year. New launches and Red Sea issues impacted both inventory days and overall CCC days.

items.statement: Net debt increased to INR8,421 million at FY24 end from INR7,671 million at start of year, net debt/EBITDA target 1-1.1x
items.quote: Our net debt was INR8,421 million as compared to INR7,671 million at the beginning of the year. The net debt has increased only by INR 750 million.

items.statement: GPI (US subsidiary) revenue was INR1,619 crores for FY24 and INR477 crores for Q4 FY24
items.quote: So GPI full year turnover INR1,619 crores, Harith and for the quarter is INR477 crores.

items.statement: MUPS block capacity utilization at 40-50%, expected to reach 70% by end of FY25
items.quote: MUPS Block, we're contributing quite well to the revenue and profitability, but actually, MUPS Block will also do a little bit of granulation and other type of compression too. And we have packaging lines. But actually going to just the M UPS products, we are doing around 40 % to 50% capacity utilization. And by the end of this year, we expect it will go up to 70%.

items.statement: Freight costs increased by INR128 million in Q4 FY24 vs Q3 FY24 due to Red Sea surcharges, INR75 million inventorized on US dispatches
items.quote: Freight expenses increased by INR 128 million compared to Q3 FY '24 mainly on account of Red Sea surcharge issues. Out of this, an amount of INR75 million is inventorized on the dispatches made to USA subsidiaries.

items.statement: Interest costs expected to remain at Q4 FY24 levels for next two quarters as Fed rates unlikely to decline in next six months
items.quote: And based on the current conditions, we see the Fed rate is not going to come down in the next six months also. So in the upcoming 2 quarters, we see the similar interest cost of Q4.

items.statement: Unit V facility received Zero 483 outcome from USFDA inspection in April 2024
items.quote: I wish to share our happiness with all of you on the Zero 483 outcome of our Unit V facility of USFDA in April this year.

items.statement: Oncology portfolio launches expected from FY26 onwards, with first-to-file, Para III and Para IV products for global markets
items.quote: These products will be developed for the global markets, and we expect to launch them from FY'26 onwards. A lot of commercial work in this direction was already taken, and we expect to play a very significant role in the overall solid oncology business across the globe in the coming years.

items.statement: CZRO green chemistry pilot plant for DCDA (108 tons/annum) commenced operations in March 2024, commercial facility planned at Kakinada
items.quote: We commenced operations for DCDA at the newly built pilot plant in Vizag during March '24. The pilot DCDA plant has a capacity of 108 tons per annum. Plants are being worked out for a larger commercial facility at Kakinada.

items.statement: Europe formulation revenue grew 32% from INR248 crores in FY23 to INR327 crores in FY24
items.quote: Our Finished Dosage business revenue has also gone up significantly in Europe and some of the chosen regulated markets. The revenue has gone up from INR248 crores in FY'23 to INR327 crores in FY'24, an increase of 32%.

items.statement: Ibuprofen sales growth will come only from volume/market share gains as prices at historic lows, European approvals and contracts secured
items.quote: Ibuprofen sales will have to ramp up only by volume increase. It is not going to be driven by value. I think the value is the lowest, and it will continue for a while. The market for these products like Paracetamol and ibuprofen don't grow too much. They grow by single digit or possibly 2 digits. And the only thing we have been growing is to get increase our market share and then very crudely put

items.statement: Capex for FY25 expected within INR250 crores including maintenance and additions
items.quote: Regarding capex, including our various manufacturing sites, maintenance capex as well as any other repairs and a few additions, we should be able to edge within about INR250 crores.

items.statement: R&D investment to continue at 5-6% of sales
items.quote: R&D, roughly the company has been investing in the range of 5% to 6% of its sales. We shall continue that.

items.statement: Europe business expected to grow 15-20% in FY25
items.quote: We should be able to post around 15% to 20% growth.

items.statement: EBITDA margin expected to bounce back to 17-18% over next few years
items.quote: I feel very confident that we should be able to bounce back to 17% to 18% over t he next few years

items.statement: Q4 FY24 EBITDA margin 13.2% vs 15% YoY; FY24 EBITDA margin 14.6% vs 17.4% YoY
items.quote: EBITDA to net sales for the quarter is 13.2% at INR574 million compared to 15% at INR642 million. EBITDA to net sales for the year is 14.6% at INR2,580 million compared to 17.4% at INR2,849 million.

items.statement: Gross margin decline due to higher sales promotion and digital marketing spend on Sensodent K
items.quote: All this has contributed. All this has contributed to lower gross margins.

items.statement: Domestic formulation grew 3.6% YoY in Q4; dermatology, ophthalmology, vitamins, urology, cardiac performed well
items.quote: Domestic formulation business, revenues from domestic formulation business for the quarter grew by 3.6% at INR1,911 million as compared to INR1,845 million. Major therapeutic segments, namely dermatology, ophthalmology, vitamins, urology and cardiac perfor med well during the quarter as compared to the same quarter last year

items.statement: API business revenue INR217 million in Q4 vs INR228 million YoY; CRO/Analytical services grew 85% to INR83 million
items.quote: Revenues from API business for the quarter are at INR217 million as against INR228 million. Revenues from AnaCipher CRO and Indoco Analytical Solutions for the q uarter grew by 85% at INR83 million against INR45 million

items.statement: India business shifting from acute to subchronic/chronic; launched Vision ophthalmology division for anti-glaucoma
items.quote: Given that we have such a large contribution coming from these two therapy areas, we have been impacted. But company has made many strategic -- taken many strategic initiatives to reduce dependence on pure acute therapy. And I'm confident, going forward, we will see more and more contributions coming from subchronic and chronic.

items.statement: Key brands performance: Cyclopam +3%, Sensodent K ~16%, KF 18%, Cital 18.5%, Rexidin/Kidodent double-digit; Febrex Plus -10%, ATM single-digit decline, Oxipod weak
items.quote: Cyclopam grew by 3%, Sensodent K by close to 16%, KF by 18%, Cital by 18.5%. Rexidin mouthwash, Kidodent, everything is in double-digit growth, Aditya, all except Febrex Plus. And within that also, it is Febrex Plus suspension, which has degrown heavily, and that is the character of the entire therapy market for the covered market. In addition to that, ATM has been -- has shown a single-digit degr

items.statement: API Kilo Lab and Indoco Analytical Services cleared US FDA audit with zero 483s
items.quote: As of 2 hours ago, happy to share that, our API Kilo Lab manufacturing facility and Indoco Analytical Services testing lab has successfully cleared the U.S. FDA audit with 0483s.

items.statement: US plant under OAI status; refurbishment underway to correct compliance issues
items.quote: As you know, we are under OAI status. And to correct that, we had to do all the refurbishment of all the lines.

items.statement: Emerging markets: 150+ MRs in French West Africa (8 countries), 32 in Kenya, 22 in Sri Lanka; sustainable branded generics model
items.quote: We have medical reps on the ground, more than 150 in French West Africa in 8 countries. In Kenya, also, we have 32 medical reps, in Sri Lanka 22, so we are promoting brands. That is the beauty of this business. So it has to be predictable.

items.statement: US FDA approvals expected: 3-4 in FY25, mostly oral solids, some sterile if FDA reinspection occurs
items.quote: Three to four we should get. And while we hope a few come in the sterile also, given if FDA is able to come down, audit and ch ange the status, we can hope for that, but otherwise, we are largely oral solids

items.statement: Paracetamol orders to UK disrupted but not gone for good; orders restarting in 15 days to 1 month
items.quote: They're not gone for good. We have visibility. Orders have started coming in, and they should accelerate within 15 days to 1 month.

items.statement: Febrex Plus suspension degrowth heavy, tied to covered market respiratory/anti-infective weakness
items.quote: And within that also, it is Febrex Plus suspension, which has degrown heavily, and that is the character of the entire therapy market for the covered market.

items.statement: Warren Remedies subsidiary commenced manufacturing in March 2024
items.quote: in the month of March, we commenced manufacturing in o ur 100% subsidiary, Warren Remedies Private Limited

items.statement: Cyclopam crossed INR150 crores revenue per IQVIA; Oxipod and Cital each crossed INR100 crores
items.quote: Earlier in the month of January this year, the largest brand of the company, Cyclopam, crossed INR150 crores revenues as per IQVAI. Other 2 brands of the company, Oxipod and Cital, had each also crossed INR100 crores mark for the company.

items.statement: Digital Health Innovator Award for Sensodent K 360-degree digital promotion; TV advertising launched
items.quote: The organization has received the Digital Health Innovator Company of the Year Award for the 360-degree promotion of Sensodent K brand through comprehensive digital strategies at DigiPharmaX 2024 event. In addition to digital promotion, we are happy to share that earlier this month, Sensodent K has also gone live on television channels to establish a broader reach to our end consumers.

items.statement: HRMS SAP SuccessFactors implemented for improved systems and controls
items.quote: And this year, we have executed the HRMS software SAP Success Factor, which will help us improve systems and controls across the organization.

items.statement: FY25 revenue growth guided at 30-35%, EBITDA margin 20-22%, PAT margin 15-16%
items.quote: We expect to continue our growth momentum in FY25, plan to deliver a planned revenue growth of between 30 % and 35%. And we will keep EBITDA and PAT margins at similar levels EBITDA between 20% and 22% and PAT between 15% and 16%.

items.statement: Won Rs.100 crore SBI deal for iCashpro+ license implementation and support
items.quote: Some of the key wins in the banking and FinTech segment include the State Bank of India, which was highly sought of the India's largest commercial bank for the license implementation and support of iCashpro+, our next generation cash management and transaction banking platform. This order was valued close to Rs.100 crore as we disclosed.

items.statement: Signed multi-million dollar partnership with US FinTech giant with initial $5M work orders for FY25
items.quote: Also, recently we signed a multi-million dollar partnership with a very prominent US FinTech giant, paving the way for significant growth in the US market as well as globally for us. We kicked off this relationship with initial work orders of about $5 million to be executed largely within this financial year.

items.statement: Won Haryana government order for 5 million open loop NCMC cards
items.quote: The key wins in this segment includes some key strategic order wins in TCL hybrid cloud space that we have disclosed and a significant order win from Government of Haryana, which covers the issuance of 5 million open loop cards.

items.statement: Acquired 67% stake in Arya.ai for Rs.135 crore; management retained; FY24 revenue Rs.22 crore growing materially faster than Aurionpro
items.quote: Over the last three years, it went from Rs. 3 crore to Rs.8 crore to Rs.22 crore, and this year we have visibility into a very strong growth that was one, on the core business.

items.statement: Arya.ai EBITDA margin 8-10 percentage points above Aurionpro (~30-32%)
items.quote: Bottom line, it's a very high EBITDA business. So, EBITDA levels are probably, I would say at least 8 to 10 points above Aurionpro.

items.statement: FY24 EBITDA margin 21.8%, PAT margin 16.1%; FY25 guided at similar levels
items.quote: EBITDA margins for the full year stood at 21.8 %. PAT stood at Rs.143 crore, which is a growth of 40% year-on-year, PAT margins for the full year came in at 16.1 % so slightly above the guidance.

items.statement: Margin optimization deferred 2-3 years; R&D investment to capitalize on large opportunities is the offset
items.quote: Offset largely is the R&D. The size of the opportunity in front of us Vimal is just so large. It's just really each of the major segments we have are staring at, kind of the size of opportunities we have not seen before.

items.statement: Indian banking tech spend surging; pipeline deals tripled in 12 months; new offerings launching next quarter
items.quote: We see a massive momentum in terms of tech-spend in India. We see a very significant opportunity in terms of transformation at a bank level when it comes to the technology stack.

items.statement: Data center demand significantly exceeds supply; business growing >50% for 3 years; productization underway
items.quote: data center is one of those spaces where there is significantly more demand than there is supply at the moment. So, of course from a demand standpoint it is just extremely strong. The business has been growing, like I said in the past has been growin g at higher than 50% levels for us now for three years in a row

items.statement: Banking segment accelerating (40-50% growth) as product build-out completes; TIG slowing to focus on unit economics and productization
items.quote: Now the roles have sort of switched banking, the product build outs are to a large extent done. So, banking will grow a lot more strongly, as you saw in Q3, and Q4 and you will see in FY25, and TIG side we will sort of focus more on driving the unit economics and, and sort of productizing a lot more.

items.statement: First successful deployment via Finastra partnership at a large bank; MasterCard and Vix partnerships to boost TIG order book
items.quote: During the quarter, we also had a first successful deployment of our product at a large bank through the strategic partnership with Finastra. These are significant proof points of the effectiveness of our strategy to partner with other global FinTech majors that we have talked about in the previous earnings calls.

items.statement: Receivable days up ~14 days due to 3 specific projects delayed by elections; expect material improvement in FY25 as banking mix rises and projects resolve
items.quote: So, we are not signing a lot more new government work that actually as a percentage of the business is gone down quite significantly. But we have some existing projects which have been running where, actually there are three spec ific ones, the combined impact is about 14 days, where we more or less addressed it, but because of elections, because of the temporary sort of situation there, the payme

items.statement: Added 600-700 people (~30-35% headcount growth) in last 12 months; hiring from global FinTech majors; scaling delivery capacity deliberately
items.quote: Over the last 12 months, we have added I would say probably 600 to 700 additional people, that's almost 30%, 35% additional capacity as well.

items.statement: Invested heavily in fixed assets, capacity, and new technology layer (ERP, CRM, HR systems) over last 12 months
items.quote: We have also made huge investments in fixed assets, in capacity, in technology layer. Over the last 12 months built out a completely brand-new technology layer in the organization across ERP, CRM, HR systems, all that stuff as well, the operating framework as well.

items.statement: Board authorized 1:1 bonus shares and doubled dividend to Rs.2.5 per share (post-bonus)
items.quote: I’m happy to share that the Board authorized issuan ce of bonus shares at a ratio of 1:1 alongside the dividend payout of INR 2.5 per equity share, this is post bonus. So, this marks a significant milestone as we doubled our dividend payout this year, reflecting we believe our commitment to delivering value to our shareholders

items.statement: FY24 revenue Rs.887 crore (+35% YoY), EBITDA Rs.193 crore (+33% YoY), PAT Rs.143 crore (+40% YoY)
items.value: Revenue Rs.887 cr; EBITDA Rs.193 cr; PAT Rs.143 cr
items.quote: To recap the performance a bit FY 24 full year revenue stood at Rs.887 crore, which is a 35% year-on-year growth, and EBITDA stood at Rs.193 crores which is 33% year-on-year growth. EBITDA margins for the full year stood at 21.8 %. PAT stood at Rs.143 crore, which is a growth of 40% year-on-year, PAT margins for the full year came in at 16.1 %

items.statement: Scaling human capital is top priority; growth capped at 30-35% to protect delivery reputation; portfolio approach used to slow segments needing retooling
items.quote: Scaling up for our increased scale across all aspects of the organization is the number one agenda for us to manage this growth. We have also made huge investments in fixed assets, in capacity, in technology layer.

items.statement: Indian banking regulatory pushback driving tech spend uptick; opportunity for transformation deals and AI-driven compliance
items.quote: We see a massive momentum in terms of tech-spend in India. We see a very significant opportunity in terms of transformation at a bank level when it comes to the technology stack. So, there is a lot of transformation, so is the right word you will need on the overall tech layer within banks when it comes to not just the digital side of things, but being able to use the modern AI assets, being able

items.statement: R&D investment hurdle rate 25% return on capital; incremental product modules pay back in ~18 months; platform builds take 5-6 years
items.quote: typically, we start with a business plan around the buil d at a 25% return on capital as the bar which we look at investments for and then over time, we will measure. The problem with the R&D spend is the returns actually come in over a period of time

items.statement: Growth deliberately paced at 30-35% despite demand for 10-15% more; portfolio strategy allows slowing segments (TIG) while accelerating others (banking)
items.quote: Purely from a demand standpoint, if you really press the pedal, I would say there is an opportunity to get other 10 points of growth or 15 points of growth. The pr oblem is, it will come at an enormous risk to delivery, reputation and ability to scale. So, we feel 30% to 35% is the level at which we can scale safely

items.statement: No fund raise mentioned; acquisitions funded from internal accruals; Arya.ai deal mostly bought out VC investors
items.quote: As you would have seen mostly we have bought out all the VC side investors in that transaction, the management continues to hold.

items.statement: Positioned as cost-efficient player with mature sales channel and global FinTech partnerships; targeting enterprise AI application layer where few mature FSI offerings exist globally
items.quote: We are probably one of the most cost efficient players around. And we have a very grown up sales channel now going out and competing for deals, all of that together really increases the size of opportunity and we really need to build against it.

items.statement: Three consecutive years of >30% growth; FY24 at high end of 35% guidance; run rate now Rs.1000+ crore
items.quote: Our full year performance came in at the high end of our growth guidance of 35% marking another milestone in our journey to build out significant global products and platforms player. It's the third consecutive year that we grew the business in excess of 30%

items.statement: Targets FY25 disbursements of INR3,600-3,800 crores and AUM of INR15,000 crores by March 2025
items.quote: the company is confident of reaching a disbursement of INR3,600 crores to INR3,800 crores, an AUM of INR15,000 crores, stage 2 numbers between 7% and 9% and GNPA below 3% by March '25.

items.statement: Targets FY25 PAT of INR450-475 crores implying 20-25% profit growth
items.quote: Anywhere between INR450 crores to INR475 crores.

items.statement: Expects FY25 NIM of 4.8-5.2% versus 5.23% in FY24 due to aggressive pricing for salaried home loans
items.quote: As far as NIM is concerned, yes, we now have a NIM of around 5.2%. But going forward, it may not be 5.2%. It may be a nywhere between 4.8% to 5.2

items.statement: Expects FY25 net credit cost to be minimal with potential negative provisions of INR20-40 crores from NPA recoveries
items.quote: The credit cost for this year is expected to be minimal.

items.statement: Targets FY25 ROA around 3% and ROE around 15.8%
items.quote: ROA should be anywhere around 3%. And ROE should be around the same. We were around 15.8%. Hopefully, we should be able to maintain around the same range.

items.statement: Targets FY25 cost-to-income ratio around 24%
items.quote: cost -to-income ratio is around 24% for the w hole year. Hopefully, with the likely increase in the income because of our recovery -- sorry, because of our expansion as well as the recovery that is going to give us income, I think this cost to the income ratio should be -- we should be able to maintain around 24

items.statement: Plans to add 40 outlets in FY25 to reach 250 total touch points
items.quote: We will be adding another 40 outlets in FY '25 to make the number of outlets to 250.

items.statement: Expects FY25 employee expense growth of 10-12% over FY24's INR102 crores
items.quote: last year, we were around INR102 crores. So maybe this time, there may be a 10% to 12% increase, that is for FY '24-25.

items.statement: Expects Phase 2 IT project to cost additional INR15-16 crores in FY25
items.quote: maybe another INR15 crores to INR16 crores will be there for Phase 2.

items.statement: Reduced GNPA from INR618 crores in Q3 FY24 to INR552 crores (4.1% of AUM) in Q4 FY24; Net NPA at 1.5%
items.quote: We were able to reduce the GNPA from INR618 crores in Q3 FY '24 to INR552 crores, which is 4.1% of the AUM. Net NPA stood at INR192 crores at 1.5%.

items.statement: FY24 full-year NPA reduction of INR168 crores; total provisions INR518 crores with 65.2% Stage 3 coverage
items.quote: We have reduced the NPA by INR168 crores for the full year. For the NPAs, we have a total provision of INR518 crores with a provision coverage ratio of 65.2% for Stage 3 assets.

items.statement: Restructured portfolio of INR528 crores as of March 2024, with INR158 crores in Stage 3
items.quote: As of March 31, 2024, we hold INR528 crores of restructured portfolio outstanding in our book, of which approximately INR158 crores are in Stage 3 and remaining in Stage 1 and 2.

items.statement: FY24 slippages INR150 crores, recoveries INR316 crores; Q4 slippages INR37 crores, recoveries INR101 crores
items.quote: INR150 crores was the slippage for the whole year, INR360 crores for the -- INR316 crores was the recoveries for the whole year. For the last quarter alone, if you want, one minute -- it is INR37 crores of slippages and INR101 crores of recovery.

items.statement: Targets FY25 net NPA reduction of INR60-100 crores and provision release of INR40-50 crores
items.quote: Going forward we expect a reduction of aro und max minimum of INR60 crores up to INR100 crores of NPA reduction. So this will help us in releasing a provision anywhere between INR40 crores to INR50

items.statement: ~INR300 crores of NPA over 1000 days old; plans simplified settlement scheme for vintage borrowers
items.quote: out of around INR500 odd crores, INR300 odd crores, I do not have the exact number, around INR300 crores is more than 1000 days old.

items.statement: New loans disbursed since Jan 2022 (INR5,700 crores) show 0.24% NPA and 1.8% Stage 2
items.quote: we have disbursed something around INR5,700 crores from January'22, which means in 27 months, we have disbursed out side of INR5,700 crores. Our NPA in this book is only INR24 crores, it is 0.24%.

items.statement: FY24 NIM 5.23% up from 4.84% in FY23; spread maintained at 3.38% with yields at 11.75%
items.quote: Our NIM for FY '24 was at 5.23%, up from 4.84% in FY '23. The company has been able to maintain a spread of 3.38% for FY '24 by raising yields to 11.75% despite facing stiff competition at our pricing levels.

items.statement: FY24 disbursements INR3,135 crores (12.7% growth ex-DA pool); sanctions INR3,340 crores (7.9% growth ex-DA pool)
items.quote: Our disbursements for FY '24 was a record high of INR3,135 crores as against INR2,919 crores of FY '23. On a comparative basis, we have registered a growth of 12.7%, excluding the DA pool buyouts done in FY '23 for INR136 crores.

items.statement: Q4 FY24 disbursements INR895 crores, sanctions INR978 crores; 9% and 16% Y-o-Y growth ex-DA pool
items.quote: We were able to achieve disbursements of INR895 crores against INR835 crores in Q4 '23. Our sanctions stood at INR978 crores as compared to INR966 crores in Q4 '23. Excluding the DA pool buyout transaction we did in Q4 '23, the growth in sanctions and disbursements are 9% and 16% Y -o-Y.

items.statement: AUM INR13,513 crores as of March 2024, up 9% Y-o-Y after INR168 crore GNPA reduction
items.quote: After taking into account GNPA reduction of INR168 crores, our AUM stands at INR13,513 crores, an increase of 9% Y-o-Y.

items.statement: Plans to maintain ~75:25 housing to non-housing mix; salaried share may rise from 52% to 53-54%
items.quote: See, as of now, the ratio between home loan and non -home loan is 75% and 25%. Under non home loan, LAP constitutes only around 15%. So going forward as well, we will be maintaining the same ratios.

items.statement: 56% of loan book from Tamil Nadu; plans to increase exposure in Karnataka, Telangana, Andhra; Tamil Nadu share may decline to 50-54%
items.quote: Gradually, of course, 56% of our loan book is from Tamil Nadu because of the effect -- base effect. So Tamil Nadu may slow -- may come down slightly, maybe from 56% it may come to 55% or 54%. We will be increasing our exposure in non-Tamil Nadu especially in the southern regions of Karnataka, Telangana, Andhra and all, that is our plan of action.

items.statement: No immediate plans for Northern India expansion; focus on existing geographies for FY25
items.quote: At least for FY '24-25, I do not want to venture into new geographies because the existing geographies itself, there are so many new places to venture into.

items.statement: Spent INR24 crores on IT transformation (LLMS, EGL); INR13.5 crores capitalized; Phase 2 underway for back-office ops
items.quote: Phase one of the project comprising of LLMS and EGL are completely integrated and fully functional. Applications planned for Phase 2 are under progress. We have so far spent INR24 crores, of these, INR13.5 crores have already been capitalized.

items.statement: Total IT project cost ~INR40 crores excluding security; INR22 crores spent; INR15-16 crores remaining for Phase 2
items.quote: the total project cost, excluding any security -related expenses is around INR40 crores. We have already spent around INR22 crores. So it will be -- maybe another INR15 crores to INR16 crores will be there for Phase 2.

items.statement: NHB funding eligibility restored as Net NPA below threshold; can access post-AGM; NHB cheaper than bank funding but allocation uncertain
items.quote: It's definitely possible because now that our net NPA has come down we become definitely eligible for our NHB funding. Of course, that can happen only post the AGM because NHB normally expects the AGM to be over.

items.statement: Plans to double collection team from ~80 to ~150 people in FY25; focus on 1-90 day overdue bucket
items.quote: We had around 80 -- 80-odd people for collection. Now we want to almost double it to around 150 for this current year. Our focus this particular year will be more on collection s, especially 1 to 90 days

items.statement: Sales force to increase from ~200 to ~300 foot-on-street personnel in FY25 (excluding branch heads)
items.quote: Last year, we had around 200 salespeople. This year, our foot-on-street sales persons will be around 300. This will be excluding the branch head, okay?

items.statement: Added Chief Business Officer; plans middle-level hires in sales, collection, underwriting; no senior-level additions
items.quote: we have already informed one CBO, Chief Business Officer, Mr. Raja has already joined and we may induct some people at the middle level under all verticals whether it is sales, collection or even in underwriting, at middle level, but not at the senior level, perhaps, but definitely at the middle level.

items.statement: FY24 PAT INR395 crores up 32% Y-o-Y; Q4 PAT INR108 crores up 32% Y-o-Y and 8.7% Q-o-Q
items.quote: For the whole year, we have earned a net profit of INR395 crores against INR296 crores for FY '23. Our ROA and ROE stood at 3% and 15.8%, respectively, for FY '24 as against the respective figures for FY '23 at 2.5% and 13.5%.

items.statement: Average ticket size for new book ~INR20 lakhs vs ~INR12-13 lakhs two years ago; overall book average ~INR12 lakhs
items.quote: Yes. Today, my average ticket size is around INR20 lakhs. 2 years back, it was only around INR12 lakhs to, INR13 lakhs. So my average ticket size for the new book is around INR20 lakhs. But for the entire book it's around INR12 lakhs.

items.statement: Expects Q1 FY25 disbursements to be dull due to branch transfers and new openings; Q2 and Q4 are peak quarters
items.quote: First quarter will be slightly dull let me admit, but going forward, yes, it will pick up. Normally for this company second and fourth quarters are peak quarters.

items.statement: FY25 revenue growth guidance of 13-16%
items.quote: the top line as you said, between 13% to 16% somewhere around there.

items.statement: US business expected to maintain at least 10% growth
items.quote: We should at least maintain a 10%.

items.statement: EBITDA margin improved 400 bps to 33% in FY24
items.quote: EBITDA margin improved by 400 basis points while PA T margins by 300 basis points.

items.statement: US EBITDA margin 37% vs India 29%
items.quote: So, we have EBITDA margin of 37% in USA and in India it is about 29%.

items.statement: Annual EBITDA margin expected around 33% with improvement as revenue grows
items.quote: if you look at on annual numbers from 29% to 33%, this is what we can expect.

items.statement: US demand visibility better after Q4 pressure
items.quote: The overall demand situation is as such I think Q4 there was some pressure on that. But apart from that, the visibility is better.

items.statement: Human nutrition growth driven by US recovery and biocatalyst
items.quote: Human nutrition we're talking some growth has to come up from the US going forward and some has to come up from the biocatalyst area in the coming few years.

items.statement: No formal order book; business is order-to-order
items.quote: So, in our business, there is no contract as such or the order book kind of things, generally order- to-order which you know the customers and you know the pains and that is where it's always difficult to predict exact numbers of re venue what it will be and exactly how it will be and quarter-and-quarter how they will

items.statement: ₹30-40 crore R&D center investment over next two years
items.quote: maybe about somewhere around ₹30-40 crores developing this R&D centers.

items.statement: Capacity utilization ~65%; expansion triggered at 80%
items.quote: The capacity should be about 65% utilization, difficult to say because it's always a cat and mouse game, at the same time when there will be the 80% utilization, probably we will go for it for the expansion, we will build up slowly, slowly small areas so that we can build it up with very fast.

items.statement: Pricing stationary; input costs stable and expected to continue
items.quote: It is more stationary, Nikhil.

items.statement: Input costs stable; logistics higher due to Red Sea but manageable
items.quote: Input cost more or less is stable in terms of raw material prices and other prices, and we expect the same to continue.

items.statement: Human nutrition mix expected 65-70% over next 2-3 years
items.quote: So, we expect it to grow, but in terms of percentage probabl y it will be between 65 % to 70% because there are some other businesses as well

items.statement: Top 10 customers 26% of revenue; top customer 4-5%

items.quote: We have received approval of two food enzyme dossiers from EFSA. Over and above, we also received no-question letter for our two GRAS filings with USFDA.

items.statement: Logistics cost elevated due to Red Sea conflict but manageable
items.quote: Some areas, the logistic cost is still on a higher side because of all this red sea conflict, which is going on, but still it is okay, manageable, it's not really impacting to a very great level the way it used to be during the COVID time and other time.

items.statement: ₹500 crore cash on balance sheet; generating ~₹100 crore annually
items.quote: we have around ₹500 crores of cash on the balance sheet, and we generate around ₹100 crores of cash every year.

items.statement: No fund raise mentioned; using cash for dividends, capex, acquisitions
items.quote: last year we have declared interim dividend, this year we are continuing with the interim dividend, and apart from that, we are keeping the cash with us to make sure that whenever we have some opportunity, we use that money and to expand our business, and apart from that the normal capital expenditures and -

items.statement: Acquired 5.89% stake in JC Biotech for ₹56.07 million; now 95.72%

items.statement: Actively seeking probiotic acquisitions; no specific target identified
items.quote: Well, we are always in search, but if you come across any good company, please let us know.

items.statement: Continuing interim dividend policy
items.quote: last year we have declared interim dividend, this year we are continuing with the interim dividend

items.statement: Building new R&D center in Nashik; 120,000 sq ft, 3x current capacity
items.quote: we have already taken a 15 -acre land during the COVID time in Nasik, in Pathardi areas, we are coming up with a new R&D center , right now we are building up about 120,000 sq uare feet building. I think it should be around three times of our current R&Ds what we are doing

items.statement: evoxx impaired ~₹18-19 crore; contract research didn't materialize
items.quote: we have taken an impairment as well this year into our balance sheets, impairment of about 18, 19 crores on the Advanced Enzymes balance sheet, if you look at it, we have taken impairment loss as well.

items.statement: R&D spend 4.58% of revenue (3.2% post-elimination)
items.quote: Our R&D expendi ture during the year is about ₹274 million as compared to ₹290 million in FY'23. Percentage of R&D expenditure on consolidated basis, we spend about 4.58% as compared to 5.06

items.quote: During Q4, there is one-time impact of ₹151 million on profitability due to adverse judgment of the court in lawsuit in one of our US subsidiary, AST Enzymes.

items.statement: Business always carries risk; no other pending litigation seen
items.quote: Business is always full of risk. I can't comment on that, but as of now, like I don't see any other thing which is there in like but it's always a risk and what will pop up tomorrow, you never know, right.

items.statement: Management expects sugar crushing of 560-570 lakh quintals for season 2024-25, subject to monsoon.
items.quote: So, overall, we are thinking around, again, this is 544, 534 next year, we are anticipating around 560, 570, but it is very early to say because the whole period of monsoon is still pending.
