items.statement: Interest cost reduction lagging debt reduction due to higher short-term borrowing rates and Europe benchmark rate increases; no further rate spikes seen
items.quote: So, Amyn the interest cost will keep coming down with the debt . There is a certain element of higher interest rates even on a working capital borrowing currently. So, on a like-to-like basis if there is any short -term borrowing during the year it is happening at a higher rate vis -a-vis the past.

items.statement: Targets 11-12% three-to-five-year CAGR for like-to-like consumption growth
items.quote: I would estimate anywhere between 11 % to 12% kind of growth.

items.quote: This would be our guidance for FY 25 that we are targeting to get about aim to sell about Rs. 400 crores.

items.statement: St Regis Mumbai Q4 FY24 ARR >Rs 21,000; FY24 ARR up 23% with >80% occupancy
items.quote: The St. Regis, Mumbai, we have seen a remarkable ARR level at more than Rs. 21,000 in Q4 FY24.

items.quote: There are probably two more real transactions that we are currently pursuing, and we should be able to conclude them in this calendar year.

items.quote: I am very pleased to welcome Mr. Kailash Gupta, as the company's group CFO. Kailash brings over 25 years of experience across various financial disciplines

items.quote: currently, we don't have any active plans on expanding on Residential. We are not in any race to become a larger Residential developer.

items.quote: What we feel now is that speciality chemical subsidiary is all set to make double digit EBITDA next year i.e. in FY'25 with more than 20% ROCE.

items.quote: At full capacity utilization, it should generate close to Rs. 125 crores of sales. The utilization of the capacity is increasing month to month. So, we expect from the second half of FY25 we should be close to 80% capacity utilization.

items.statement: Metallized capacitor film capacity utilization reached ~2/3 in Q4 FY24; annual revenue potential Rs 60-70 crore at peak
items.quote: At peak we would be touching close to 60-70 crores annual revenue, but we would be scaling this business in the times to come.

items.statement: Board recommended dividend of Rs 3 per share for FY24

items.statement: Credit rating reaffirmed at CRISIL AA- with stable outlook

items.quote: On BOPP, the demand growth is quite good and there are no new players coming in the next two three quarters.

items.quote: Very broadly, you can say close to 1000 crore rupee of extra revenue may get generated from the proposed BOPP line and CPP line taken together and on the top of it, the new verticals like the capacitor, metallizer, rigid packaging, etc., may add close to 200 crore additionally.

items.statement: Sun control film capacity potential Rs 100-125 crore top line; in-house dyeing technology developed; initial B2B model with future B2C
items.quote: broadly, I Cosmo First Ltd May 16th, 2024 can indicate to you the current capacity may have potential to generate between 100 crores to 125 crore top line

items.quote: This year also we have communicated that we will increase our stores from 23 to 40.

items.quote: We have seen a lot of consolidation in South America. We have seen a lot of consolidation in Europe. We have hardly seen any consolidation in India.

items.quote: I would like to give guidance for FY '25 EXIM, we are hoping 15% growth. Domestic, we are hoping 25% growth. That makes overall 18% to 20% growth in FY '25.

items.statement: EBITDA margin maintained at 25% for FY25

items.quote: See, I am not in a position to answer this question because this is related to the policy of the Government of India, which I am not competent to comment in this conference call.

items.quote: See, it has been a conscious decision of the company not to sacrifice our margins for gaining market share. We are retaining our customers, getting new customers while maintaining our margins. So, that is the primary reason.

items.quote: Yes, as per the Dedicated Freight Corridor officers, JNPT will be commissioned on DFC by March 2025. That is a projection they have given.

items.quote: We have recently announced a new expansion capex of INR5,400 crores and revamped capex of INR275 crores to restart and scale up the new acquisitions of Rathi, Chromeni and Rabirun. And we're getting the total capex to INR5,675 crores over the next 3 years.

items.statement: Q1 FY25 expected to be better than Q4 FY24 as Red Sea impact stabilizes and nickel prices recover
items.quote: Q1 is expected to be better than Q4.

items.statement: Nickel prices fell continuously for 9 months (April to Jan-Feb), sharpest decline in Q3, impacting margins despite volume growth
items.quote: Unprecedently for the nine months, this year the nickel prices continuously fall. And if you see in the quarter 3, the fall was even steeper.

items.statement: FY24 product mix: 200 series 35%, 300 series 45%, 400 series 20% (vs 24% in FY23), strategy to increase 400 series applications
items.quote: In FY'24, basically series wise, 200 serie s at almost 35%; 300 series was close to around 45%; and 400 was around 20

items.statement: JUSL (JV) processed 464,000 tons in Q4 FY24 and 1.7 million tons in full FY24
items.quote: It is 4, 64,000 is the quantity that job work has been done by the JUSL for the full year -- for the quarter 4.

items.statement: Chinese imports surged 20% YoY in FY24 and 20% QoQ in Q4, flooding market with substandard exports threatening MSMEs
items.quote: On the import side, imports from China continue to surge with around 20% increase on a year-on-year basis. With a consistent increase in Chinese dumping, the stainless steel market in India continues to be flooded by substandard exports.

items.statement: Government dialogue ongoing on Chinese dumping, no immediate relief expected, medium-term measures may help MSME sector more than large players
items.quote: So the dialogue is always on, and we always expect that something positive should come out, but immediately, in the short term, I don't see anything, maybe in the medium term, some relief could come, but nothing to really mention at the moment.

items.statement: FY25 closing debt expected at INR5,100-5,200 crores (increase of INR300-400 crores excluding spillover), average debt maturity 4.5-5 years
items.quote: We expect the closing debt of FY '25 to be at around INR5,100 crores to INR5,200 crores, which is an increase of only INR300 crores to INR400 crores, excluding the spillover capex of FY '24.

items.statement: Board recommended final dividend of INR2 for FY24, total FY24 dividend INR3 (150% of face value INR2), dividend payout policy targeting 20% gradually but capex priority may delay
items.quote: I'm happy to share that Board of Directors have recommended a final dividend payment of INR2 for FY '24, subject to approval of shareholders, taking the total dividend payment for FY '24 to INR3, which is 150% per equity share with a face value of INR2 each.

items.statement: Acquired 54% stake in Chromeni Steels (Mundra) for INR1,340 crores (INR1,295 crores debt takeover + equity), evaluating residual stake purchase
items.quote: We are acquiring a 54% stake in Chromeni Steels, which is located in Mundra, Gujarat. The transaction entaile d an outlay of INR1,340 crores comprising the takeover of existing shareholder debt at around INR1,295 crores and balance towards equity

items.statement: Acquired additional 30% stake in Spain subsidiary Iberjindal for EUR30,000, now hold 95%
items.quote: I'm happy to share that we have acquired 30% stakes, i.e., 300,000 shares of face value of Euro1.0 each at EUR0.10 per share with a total consideration of EUR 30,000. Accordingly, we now hold 95% stake in the Spain subsidiary.

items.statement: Divested 4.87% stake in JCL, exploring divestment of balance 21.12% by September 30, 2024 at par or higher valuation
items.quote: With regard to the divestment of the stake in JCL, the company has divested 4.87% stake and exploring the option to divest the balance 21.12% stake, which will be completed by 30th September.

items.statement: FY24 standalone sales volume 23% YoY growth to record high, Q4 volume 570,362 tons (12% YoY, 11% QoQ)
items.quote: We delivered the highest average sales volume of 5,70,362 metric ton in quarter, increased by 12% on Y-o-Y and 11% on quarter-on-quarter basis. Accordingly, we had a strong sales volume growth of 23% in FY '24.

items.statement: Red Sea crisis continues to pressure export freight costs and margins, export EBITDA margins not great, domestic push to continue
items.quote: Exports are going to remain under pressure because the freight cost is still high and therefore the export EBITDA margins are not looking that great which we would have expected.

items.statement: If billing grows 15-16% YoY, margins can be maintained; 20% growth helps improve margins; 9-10% growth may dip margins short term
items.quote: If we are able to grow our revenue, grow our billing by 15-16% year on year, we should be able to maintain margin. If we are able to grow at 20%, that will help us improve our margins. And if we grow at 9-10%, then our margins might take a dip in the short term.

items.statement: Recruitment operating margin was 57% in Q4 FY24, down 2% YoY due to flat billing growth and higher manpower, marketing, overhead costs
items.quote: Operating profit was lower 2% YOY at Rs. 258 crores and the operating profit margin was 57%.

items.statement: Standalone operating margin improved 250 bps YoY to 36.6% for full year FY24
items.quote: Operating profits at a standalone level grew 18% year-on-year to Rs. 871 crore and the operating margin was 36.6%, a YOY growth of 250 basis points.

items.statement: IT hiring slowdown impacted ~45-50% of recruitment business; non-IT segments (manufacturing, real estate, healthcare, BFSI) sustained growth
items.quote: FY24 was a challenging year for the overall recruitment business largely because of the slowdown in IT hiring, which is approximately 45-50% of our business, directly and indirectly if you would include the business from recruitment consultants.

items.statement: Q4 billing growth broad-based: IT grew 11%, non-IT grew 12%, consultant segment flattish; more IT jobs posted and CVs viewed vs 3-4 months ago
items.quote: The billing growth in Q4 was broad-based with IT also growing at 11% and non-IT growing at 12% and the consultant segment being flattish.

items.statement: Recruitment billings grew 7% YoY to Rs. 625 cr in Q4 FY24; full year billings grew 1% to Rs. 1,883 cr
items.quote: In Q4 of FY24, recruitment billings grew by 7% to Rs. 625 crores and revenue grew by 3% to Rs. 452 crores.

items.statement: 99Acres billings grew 26% YoY to Rs. 131 cr in Q4 FY24; full year billings grew 24% to Rs. 385 cr
items.quote: In Q4FY24, billings grew by 26% to Rs. 131 crores and revenue grew by 23% to Rs. 93 crores.

items.statement: Jeevansathi billings grew 26% YoY to Rs. 26 cr in Q4 FY24; full year billings grew 17% to Rs. 85 cr
items.quote: In Q4FY24, billings grew by 26% to Rs. 26 crores and revenue grew by 29% to Rs. 24 crores.

items.quote: In Q4FY24, billings grew by 9% to Rs. 45 crores and revenue grew by 22% to Rs. 39 crores.

items.quote: In general, it will stick within 1% or 2% of where we've historically been. They won't move very much.

items.quote: The domestic market , all indications are that it could grow very robustly. The lack of order booking in Q3 and Q4 in domestic market and actually for the last 4-5 months of the financial year led to what was expected to be a very good growth in the market to approximately 2,500 -odd MWs. But it probably came in somewhere in the region of about 2,100 - 2,200 MWs.

items.statement: Export revenue grew 38% y-o-y in FY24; US service subsidiary established with hiring, leased shed, machinery ordered, on track for business plan
items.quote: Export growth was backed by our order booking in the previous financial year, which is also driven by the initiatives and efforts that the Company has made in terms of expanding its presence overseas and becoming more locally present.

items.statement: Aftermarket contributed 33% of total turnover in FY24; turnover crossed ₹5 billion for first time, order booking crossed ₹6 billion
items.quote: The turnover at the same time was ₹5.38 billion, which was higher by 31% and aftermarket contributed 33% of the total turnover in FY 24.

items.statement: IPR filings and registrations increased to 374 from 338 a year ago; focus on supercritical/subcritical/transcritical CO2-based offerings
items.quote: Our total Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) filings and registration s stand at 374, which is up from 338 a year ago.

items.statement: Workforce expanded 19% in FY24; average age maintained below 30 years; strong succession planning with internal CEO and COO appointments
items.quote: The Company expanded its workforce by 19% over this past year and we are very keen to have all of these assets of the Company contribute in the coming year.

items.statement: Board recommended final dividend of 130% (₹1.30 per ₹1 share) for FY24, in addition to interim and special dividend of 230% (₹2.30) already paid
items.quote: The Board of Directors has also recommended a payment of a final dividend of 130%, which is ₹1.30 per ₹1 share for the financial year 2023 -24

items.statement: Investments including cash at ₹8.83 billion, up 32% y-o-y, driven by higher profitability, increased negative working capital and more customer advances
items.quote: Investments, including cash stood at ₹8.83 billion, which is an increase of 32% over March 31, 2023, which is driven by higher profitability, an increase in negative working capital and more customer advances.

items.statement: Company holds top 2 global market position; marketing and sales strength added considerably
items.quote: We continue to be quite strong in the market and hold our positions of being in the top 2 globally.

items.statement: US Inflation Reduction Act and fiscal incentives create opportunity; election uncertainty may affect timing
items.quote: From the product side, there are a l ot of incentives that the Government of the United States has provided under The Inflation Reduction Act and a variety of different fiscal incentive schemes. We'll have to wait for that uncertainty of the elections also to play out.

items.statement: Commodity price pressures seen in copper; manageable but monitored
items.quote: we d o see some commodity pressures in areas like copper, etc. But having said that, those are all manageable

items.statement: Enquiry pipeline strong domestically across cogeneration, steel, cement, industrial power; order finalisation delayed due to election cycle
items.quote: Enquiry pipeline is strong from all the industrial power range applications.

items.statement: Commodity price issues from past largely behind; copper pressures emerging but manageable
items.quote: The commodity price -based issue that we had in the past are somewhat in a sense behind us though we d o see some commodity pressures in areas like copper, etc.

items.statement: Plan to open 8 new restaurants in current fiscal year and minimum 25 new restaurants over next 3 years
items.quote: In the years t o come next this current year we are on track to open 8 new restaurants on 9th May coming. And in the next 3 years we would be opening minimum of 25 new restaurants

items.statement: New store openings caused margin decline in Q4 due to introductory pricing and 6-8 month breakeven period
items.quote: Because of the fact that we've added new stores fi ve of them and as you know that they take time to become mature. So we also have to give invi tation and introductory prices to get in more footfall for a period of 3 months to 4 months after which we slowly add and come back to a level

items.statement: Kitchen-within-kitchen model runs 3 delivery brands (Mainland China, Asia Kitchen, Hakka) from one kitchen with fixed manpower
items.quote: During pandemic, we quickly adapted that all the Asian brands in the form of Mainland China, which was the mother brand, supposing it's in Andheri Wes t, we added Asia Kitchen delivery there, and also actually pressed the button on a brand cal led Hakka, which has a few dine-in restaurants only in the city of Calcutta, and we go t that into the kitchen. So it's called the kitchen within kitchen. S

items.statement: No JV/tie-up planned currently; focusing on organic leverage of Mainland China and Episode brands
items.quote: See, everybody has their own priorities. But at th e moment, as we are looking at, we are very bullish on the fact that we will be able to leverag e the Mainland China brand, the Oriental brands, which is KitchenVision, KitchenVR, adding deliveries coming through. So, we are not looking at any opportunity to get tied up currently

items.statement: Renovated stores show 25% overall revenue jump (food, liquor, delivery)
items.quote: with this we've also understood that we do have a 25% overall revenue jump which includes our liquor, food, as well as delivery for the units.

items.statement: Average monthly revenue per 2,500 sq ft store INR 60-90 lakh depending on location and delivery
items.quote: See, there is a big range here. It could be betwee n INR60 lakhs to INR90 lakhs of, depending upon the location and the delivery

items.statement: Loyalty program 'Speciality Privilege' being relaunched digitally after pandemic hiatus
items.quote: In fact, last night was the fi nal discussion to do this. You see, pre- pandemic, we had a loyalty program, speciality priv ilege. And during that period, it just dithered out and we couldn't get this back for many other priorities that we had. So, we are in the process of doing this. At the moment, it is, as you know, it is all digital. So, it becomes much easier for us to do it. So, very soon, y

items.statement: Short-term margin pressure from new store breakeven (6-8 months); careful site selection to mitigate
items.quote: So, in the short term, there may be some pain, but you will see over a period of time, everything changes around because we have to add nu mber of stores. But this time, very carefully looking at the matrix and the diaspora, city, etc. which we are very careful about but it will be slow and steady growth

items.statement: Catering vertical 'Speciality Experiences' growing: 1 banqueting hall in Kolkata finishing, 1 in Mumbai renovating, Bandra partnership possible; asset-light outdoor catering also
items.quote: So, we've already built one banqueting hall in Cal cutta which is fairly large. It's getting into finishing stages. So, the second one is coming in Bombay where we already have an asset and we are renovating that. And there could be a possib ility in Bombay City, in Bandra. We are under discussions to do that and internally we've a ctually got a vertical for catering which is called Speciality Exp

items.statement: Targets INR 400-450 crores AUM and INR 500 crores gross revenue with 10% EBITDA margin for FY25
items.quote: I think the AUM growth, given the partnerships that we have created and built, I think the INR 400 crores, INR 450 crores, INR 475 crores number, I think is not a pipe dream. We will probably end up achieving this.

items.statement: Expects to reach INR 50 crores EBITDA in FY25
items.quote: Yes, so I think EBITDA guidance, I think the plan is that this year, we should be able to get to that level, right in the ballpark, I would say, that was the plan, I think we are working towards that construct, as we speak.

items.statement: Achieved adjusted EBITDA breakeven (ex-ESOP) in Q4 FY24
items.quote: I am pleased to report that we have concluded FY '24 on a strong note with two key developments. Number one, we broke even at the adjusted EBITDA level, which is ex-ESOP in Q4- FY 24, an important milestone in our journey.

items.statement: iServeU turned EBITDA positive on standalone basis in Q4 FY24
items.quote: iServeU on a stand-alone basis, I am happy to report, has also turned EBITDA positive this quarter.

items.statement: AUM grew 13% Q-o-Q to INR 179 crores in Q4 FY24
items.quote: In terms of the quarter on the lending side, we saw the AUM increase by 13% Q-o-Q to close at INR 179 crores.

items.statement: Fintech channel now contributes ~45% of AUM mix, up from 20% since Oct 2023 launch
items.quote: I am happy to report that the fintech channel now contributes nearly 45% of our AUM mix up from 20% since its launch in October 2023.

items.statement: Signed contract for soundbox platform supporting ~500,000 soundboxes for leading PSU bank, execution from Q1 FY25
items.quote: We have backed a contract for providing a soundbox platform supporting nearly 500,000 soundboxes for a leading PSU bank. We expect to execute this contract Q1 FY 25 onwards.

items.statement: Acquired SuperScan AI toolkit from Orbo.ai for INR 8 crores cash + up to INR 8 crores deferred consideration; housed in Niyogin AI Private Limited
items.value: INR 8 crores cash + up to INR 8 crores deferred
items.quote: An initial amount of INR 8 crores will be paid as cash and a maximum amount of another INR 8 crores will be paid as deferred consideration depending on the performance of the company and basis some pre-agreed milestones.

items.statement: Acquired 8 AI-trained engineers with SuperScan; plans to deploy team for new product development
items.quote: I'm also getting the guys who build the tech. And what we can do with these guys, and they're all very smart people, right? We've obviously spent a fair bit of time meeting them, talking to them, making sure that they are committed to what our vision is.

items.statement: Plans to raise INR 200 crores additional debt in FY25 (INR 100 crores from existing lenders, INR 100 crores from new sources) to fund AUM growth
items.quote: Out of that, these three lenders have lent us INR 60 crores. So we definitely feel that because of the good track record and relationship with the three lenders, out of the INR 200 crores incremental, we are expecting about INR 100 crores from these three lenders only. For remaining INR 100 crores, we are in talks with a few bankers, few NBFCs, we are looking out some different types of funding al

items.statement: Raised INR 60 crores from 3 lenders (1 bank, 2 NBFCs) in FY24; rated by Crisil
items.quote: So as you are aware, during the FY24, we raised total of INR 60 crores from three lenders. Bank and two NBFCs.

items.statement: AePS volumes contracted industry-wide due to fraud concerns and RBI advisories
items.quote: AePS again the whole market has contracted a little bit because there have been instances of some frauds that have happened on people misusing Aadhaar data and fingerprints of customers by cloning those and drawing money, not with us, but this is an industry level thing that happened because of which RBI also came back quite strongly.

items.statement: Gross take rate fell from 34 bps to 29 bps Q-o-Q; net take rate from 6 bps to 5 bps due to higher payout product share
items.quote: Gross take rates decreased sequentially from 34 bps to 29 bps in Q4 of FY24, while net take rate decreased from 6 bps to 5 bps as the contribution from payout product increased. Payout has one of the lowest product economics, thus dragging the take rate.

items.statement: Expects normalization of UPI product economics to improve take rates in coming quarters
items.quote: The normalization of UPI product economics is expected to have a positive impact on take rates in the coming quarters.

items.statement: Non-GTV revenues (SaaS, soundbox tech, SuperScan) expected to become as large or larger than GTV business in contribution terms over next 3-4 years
items.quote: My expectation is that the non-GTV business should be almost as big, if not bigger than the GTV business. Because the GTV business and I'm talking not purely from a revenue standpoint I'm talking from contribution standpoint because that's what really matters.

items.statement: Soundbox revenue model flexible: per-transaction, monthly per-device rental, or device sales; annuity-focused
items.quote: Even in the soundboxes, the technology is going to be like, either it'll be on a per transaction basis, or it could be on a monthly, software cost that they have to pay us on a per device basis. So the number of devices into what we charge per month on device is how we will think about the revenue model with the current banks we're talking to.

items.statement: Distribution business (NiyoBlu) scaling: 5,500+ CA partners; loan originations >INR 30-40 crores/month; targeting INR 100 crores/month soon
items.quote: Today, we are going in excess of INR 30 crores, INR 40 crores a month. I think we'll get to 100 crores a month pretty soon in the next few months.

items.statement: Lending partnerships with KhataBook, Karma Life, Fatakpay, Capital Trust; credit losses sub-1% with 5% FLDG
items.quote: And I'm very confident to tell you that the loss norms have all been below sub 1%. And sub 1% loss norms, when we are sitting on a 5% FLDG as allowed by RBI, which is also the reason I made the comment earlier on that the RBI's clarification on FLDG guidelines has just opened up this market in a big time to us.

items.statement: RBI FLDG guideline clarification provides significant opportunity for tech-first NBFC; positive impact on lending and distribution
items.quote: We welcome the recent clarification from the regulator on FLDG guidelines which apart from providing the clarity for the industry also creates a significant opportunity for a tech-first NBFC like us. We expect it to have a positive impact on both our lending as well as our distribution franchise.

items.statement: Processed 48,089 loans in Q4 FY24, up 822% YoY and 93% QoQ
items.quote: We further processed 48,089 loans through our network in Q4 of FY24 and reported an increase of 822% year-on-year and 93% quarter-on-quarter.

items.statement: GTV including payouts INR 11,034 crores in Q4 FY24 (down 2% QoQ, up 90% YoY); 30 million transactions
items.quote: The gross transaction value that is GTV, including payouts, stood at approximately INR11,034 crores in Q4 of FY24, a marginal decrease of 2% quarter-on-quarter and up 90% year-on-year. Our transaction volumes stood at nearly 30 million compared to 42 million in Q3 FY24.

items.statement: Finance professional network grew 13% YoY to 5,884 as of March 31, 2024
items.quote: Our finance professional network increased by 13% year-on-year and stood at 5,884 as of 31st March 2024.

items.statement: iServeU recovered INR 1.2 crores against provisions in Q4 FY24; expects trend to continue
items.quote: I am happy to report that iServeU has seen some recoveries amounting to INR1.2 crores to this effect for Q4 FY 24. Going forward, we expect to see this trend to continue.

items.statement: Hired new CRO (Hitesh) and ex-founder Sanket (ex-Minko) to strengthen credit and business teams
items.quote: We also invested in making sure that we have a much stronger credit team. As you know, we hired a new CRO last year, who's actually now scaled up. He's a fantastic partner, Hitesh, on the team. I must also say that we've now got a great business guy on the team, this guy called Sanket, who's an ex-founder of a fintech startup, Minko which he has sold and he has now joined us.

items.statement: FY25 consolidated revenue guided at INR 875-935 crores, ~15-20% growth
items.quote: In my opinion, we should be close to INR 875 crores to INR 935 crores.

items.statement: FY26 consolidated revenue expected above INR 1,100 crores with ~10% EBITDA margin
items.quote: I think that within FY25-26, we should be, closely in a bracket of more than INR 1,100 crores also.

items.statement: FY25 expects at least 20% growth in top line and bottom line over FY24
items.quote: I expect at least 20% growth in terms of the top line as well as in the bottom line.

items.statement: Planned capex of INR 215 crores funded via internal accruals and promoter preferential issue
items.quote: Our planned capex of INR 215 crores, primarily funded through internal accruals and a preferential issue to the promoter, will facilitate the expansion of our existing capabilities.

items.statement: FY24 consolidated capex of INR 50 crores completed: INR 16.12 crores for 3.8 MW solar, INR 33.46 crores for chemical and fertilizer verticals
items.quote: During the financial year, we successfully completed the consolidated capex of INR 50 crores, out of which INR 16.12 crores was allotted for the further establishment of 3.8-megawatt DC solar power plant and INR 33.46 crores were directed towards investment in our Chemical and Fertilizer verticals.

items.statement: Unit 6 fertilizer expansion: 150,000 tons capacity; Unit 4 water-soluble fertilizer: 12,000 tons
items.quote: In Unit 6 we are building up a facility of 1,50,000 tons. Aditya Sen: And Unit 4? Punit Makharia: Unit 4 is, that's a specialty product. That is why we call it as a WS water-soluble fertilizer. The installed capacity would be around 12,000 tons

items.statement: Solar capacity expanding from 5.2 MW to 9 MW DC via 3.8 MW addition at Ahmednagar for open access to Maharashtra units
items.quote: Existing solar is of 5.2. New solar is of 3.8. Total will be 9 MW solar. That whole 9 MW solar will be in open access for our units in Maharashtra of Shree Pushkar.

items.statement: Standalone Q4 EBITDA margin 11.6% (up from prior); FY24 standalone EBITDA margin 9.1%; consolidated FY24 EBITDA margin 8.4%
items.quote: Our EBITDA for the quarter grew significantly by 36% to INR 16 crores, resulting in an EBITDA margin of 11.6%.

items.statement: Targets ~10% EBITDA margin by FY26 if conditions improve
items.quote: I can tell you what I expect is that at least we should be in a range of maybe 10% or so around.

items.statement: Order book visibility improved in Q4; expects continued improvement in coming quarters
items.quote: Basically, whatever I had said, my trust level has proved in Q4 levels. And in coming quarters of this financial year, I also have the same kind of a feeling that the things will improve much better.

items.statement: Dyes Intermediate volume +82%, revenue +64%; Acid volume +19% but revenue -26% due to internal consumption in Unit 5; Fertilizer volume flat, revenue -13%; Animal feed volume -10%, revenue -21%
items.quote: Dyes Intermediate saw a significant volume growth of 82% and Acid grew by 19%, while Fertilizer and Animal feed experienced marginal declines. Revenue from Dyes Intermediate grew by 64%, whereas Acid revenue declined by 26%.

items.statement: Acid volume decline due to internal consumption in new Unit 5 for Dyes Intermediates production
items.quote: So, there is a less amount, less, these quantities of acid available for sale because we have started another plant at unit 5 because of which the volumes have gone up. So, we are having an internal consumption of our acid.

items.statement: Rock phosphate price stable at $140-148/ton; denies analyst's claim of $305 to $200 drop
items.quote: It has been always, in the range of $140 to $148. And right now, also, it is almost in the range of $142. It was never at the level of $300 or $200.

items.statement: Government increased fertilizer subsidy by ~INR 1,200/ton in April after September cut; expects sentiment improvement post-elections
items.quote: the government has improved the subsidy levels also by around INR 1,200 and some odd per ton, which was decreased in September. But now Shree Pushkar Chemicals & in April, the government has increased the subsidy

items.statement: China losing global market share in dyes; India consolidating as major supplier; China domestic consumption 80-85% vs India 12-15%
items.quote: The global market share of China is going down every year by year. So, what five years before we used to feel a pressure from China. Now I believe that China feels a pressure from India on them.

items.statement: Business affected by geopolitical situations; cannot control everything; cautious handling needed
items.quote: We are doing a business which is affected by many kinds of geopolitical situations, wherein we can't control each and everything. But we can cautiously handle the things.

items.statement: ROCE 9.7%, ROE 4.1% for FY24
items.quote: Our return on capital employed for FY 24 stands at 9.7% and our return on equity is 4.1%.

items.statement: Expects volume growth of more than 15% in FY25 if power demand grows 7-8%
items.quote: if the demand in the country increases by 8%, we should be able to grow more than 15%.

items.statement: Expects REC segment volume growth of 25-30% in FY25
items.quote: REC segment, we are expecting almost about 25% to 30% growth.

items.statement: Expects green market volume growth of 50% in FY25
items.quote: still 50% kind of volume growth should happen in the green market because green market volume this year was slightly on the lower side.

items.statement: Expects long-duration contract volume of 15 BU in FY25
items.quote: Almost about 15 BU is our expectation.

items.statement: Government projects spot market share of 25% of total generation by 2030
items.quote: Government of India, in fact, has been working on this. And in the draft National Electricity Plan, they have projected a number of 25% for the spot market, of the total generation by 2030.

items.statement: Power demand grew 12% in first 45 days of FY25, expected to grow 8% for full year
items.quote: In the first 45 days of this year, that demand has grown by almost 12%. And during this year it is expected to grow by almost about 8%.

items.statement: Short-term market share of generation increased to 15% in FY24 from 13% in FY23
items.quote: the short-term market has grown to almost about 15% of the country's generation, up from 13% in FY '23.

items.statement: IEX traded 110 BU in FY24, up 13.8% YoY; electricity volume crossed 100 BU for first time
items.quote: For FY '24, IEX traded 110 billion units, a growth of 13.8% over FY '23. Electricity volume at nearly 102 billion units crossed 100 billion unit mark for the first time since inception and were higher by 12% on a year-on-year basis.

items.statement: REC and EScert volume reached 84 lakh certificates in FY24, up 37% YoY
items.quote: A total of nearly 84 lakh certificates including REC and EScerts were traded in this year which was almost 37% higher.

items.statement: Long-duration contracts volume reached 10 BU in FY24 vs 1.6 BU in FY23
items.quote: Already, long-duration contracts in FY '24 on the exchange platform recorded 10 billion units which is much higher than 1.6 billion which we did in FY '23.

items.statement: IGX traded 40.8 million MMBtu in FY24, PAT of INR23 crore, down 18% YoY
items.quote: Due to wide variation in demand and supply of gas, IGX traded volume for FY '24 was 40.8 million MMBtu. The profit after tax for IGX for FY '24 is INR23 crores, about 18% lower with respect to FY '23.

items.statement: Consolidated PAT grew 15% to INR350.8 crore in FY24; Q4 PAT grew 9.5% to INR96.7 crore
items.quote: For FY '24, our consolidated PAT recorded INR350.8 crores, higher by 15% over the previous financial year.

items.statement: Exchange business operates at 86-87% margin; margins should improve with volume growth due to fixed cost base
items.quote: See, in case of exchange business, since other costs are fixed costs, practically, margins should improve. As it is, we are operating at a pretty high margin of almost about 86%, 87%.

items.statement: DAM clearing price fell 18% YoY to INR4.80/unit in Q4 FY24; FY24 average fell 12% to INR5.24/unit
items.quote: The average market clearing price in the DAM segment during quarter 4 FY '24 period was INR4.80 per unit compared to INR5.83 in quarter 4 of FY '23, a decline of almost about 18%.

items.statement: REC prices fell to lowest ever INR185 from INR1,000 in April 2023
items.quote: Since the new REC regulations , prices have continuously become more competitive and were traded at the lowest ever price of INR185 against INR 1,000 in April '23.

items.statement: Transaction fee on REC remains per certificate; no change despite price drop to INR170-190 range
items.quote: On REC side also, when the REC rates were INR3,500 at that time also we were charging only this fees. So this fees is per certificate. So as of now, let's see if that price continues in the range of 170, 180, 190 for a long time, we will review that.

items.statement: MoP amended rules mandating URS power sale on exchange with penalty for non-compliance; 50-60 MU/day now offered
items.quote: In quarter 4, Ministry of Power amended the rules which mandate generators having PPA to offer URS power in the market. These rules also provide for penalty in terms of reduced fixed charges to gencos if they fail to offer URS power in the market.

items.statement: CERC simulation study found no merit in coupling plain vanilla DAM/RTM; RTM-SCED coupling simulation still in progress
items.quote: In that order, CERC has made one thing very clear that they did simulation studies for 3 months for January, February, March data of '23, and based on those simulation studies, they have found that there is practically no merit in doing coupling of plain vanilla DAM market or RTM market.

items.statement: CERC staff paper on bidding rationalisation has no impact as generators already quote based on marginal cost
items.quote: See, we don't see any impact of that. In fact, if you analyze the price quoted by the generators, on the exchange platform , it is based on the marginal cost basis only.

items.statement: Launched ancillary market and high price term-ahead market in FY24; awaiting CERC approval for 11-month term-ahead contracts
items.quote: In FY '24, we launched the ancillary market , high price term ahead market and also are currently awaiting approval from CERC on our petition to extend the term ahead market from 90 days to 11 months.

items.statement: Carbon market launch delayed 5-6 months due to policy uncertainty on voluntary vs mandatory offset market
items.quote: We are working with BEE also. And maybe in due course of time, if there is a clarity and we see there is still a good opportunity in the voluntary market, we will go ahead with that. But I think we will need another 5, 6 months' time for that clarity to come.

items.statement: ICX (carbon exchange) not yet launched; no transactions so far
items.quote: Yes. As of now, nothing.

items.statement: Discoms contribute ~50% of exchange volumes; selling surplus power at competitive rates
items.quote: The sale by distribution companies also is almost about 50% of the exchange volumes.

items.statement: IEX holds 99.9% share in DAM/RTM, 55% in term-ahead, 50% in DAC, 70% in certificates; 84% comprehensive electricity share
items.quote: overall, if I talk about comprehensive market share, it is 84% for electricity and 83% overall, which includes certificates.

items.statement: 20 GW thermal capacity expected to commission in FY25; 50 GW more in next 4-5 years; 150 GW green energy under implementation
items.quote: Further, around 20 gigawatt of thermal capacity addition is expected during the year, which will increase thermal generation by almost about 10%.

items.statement: BESS capacity of 4,000 MWh to be developed in RE-rich states via viability gap funding; charging/discharging may happen through exchange
items.quote: To enable renewa ble power integration with the grid, MoP recently finalized viability gap funding mechanism to develop battery energy storage system (BESS). And to begin with BESS capacity of 4,000 megawatt hour will be developed on this proposed model in RE rich states

items.statement: Cross-border trade volume reached ~4 BU in FY24, up 52% YoY; real-time market operational since Q3 FY24
items.quote: in FY '24 we traded almost 4 billion units of volume in cross-border transactions, an increase of 52% on a year-on-year basis.

items.statement: Trade receivables jumped to INR86 crore from INR7 crore due to banking holidays on March 29-31
items.quote: 29th March was a Good Friday and 30th , 31st March banking operations were not there. So, all the credit was settled on the next working day, mainly because of banking holiday.

items.statement: Board announced final dividend of INR1.5 per share (150% of face value) for FY24
items.quote: Also, the Board of Directors of the company announced a final dividend of INR1.5 equivalent to 150% of the face value of equity share.

items.statement: Market coupling implementation is a long-term theoretical exercise; no near-term impact expected
items.quote: I think there is no point in talking about if coupling happens. I think it is a long way to go. Many more years for that to happen, because as I told you, it is only a theoretical exercise , a research work which is happening.

items.statement: FY25 revenue target of INR 23,000 crores and order inflow of INR 20,000-25,000 crores
items.quote: If our turnover this year was INR 21,700 and next year we plan for INR23,000 crores, So the order book all the time should be available INR92,000 to INR 1,00,000 crores. So, the basic parameter which we want to monitor is that we should have the order book all the time three to four times and roughly INR 1,00,000 crores. And accordingly whatever we are participating in the market nomination has be

items.statement: Current order book stands at INR 85,000 crores with aspirational target of INR 1,00,000 crores
items.quote: Presently, the order book is around 85,000 crores. And earlier during the investors meet, I had said that in FY23-24, we are trying to get 21,000 crores plus the top line. And the bottom line, I had said 1,400 crores plus. Both of the things have happened.

items.statement: Bidding projects (Indore Metro 10.66%, Maldives 11%) achieved >10% margins vs 8.5% nomination margin
items.quote: The first project in India, which we secured through bidding, was the Indore Metro project. And the first overseas project, the Maldives, which we had taken through the bidding process. These two projects have given an earning of, the Maldives project was 11%, Indore project was 10.66% margin.

items.statement: Vande Bharat manufacturing at Latur to start Nov-Dec 2024; first prototype by Sep 2025; ramp-up to 25 trainsets/year from year 3
items.quote: The schedule of manufacturing is that we have to start from the November, December 24. And the first prototype supply is likely to be completed by September 25. And then in first year, 12 numbers, second year, 18 numbers, third year onwards, 25 numbers.

items.statement: Focus shifting to capacity augmentation projects as electrification scope diminishes; targeting high-speed rail corridors under Viksit Bharat 2047
items.quote: We are basically interested more and more interest in capacity augmentation projects because that is the kind of projects which we have handled in the past. We have got the expertise in execution of this typical railway infrastructure project.
